import BaseModel, Field, model_validator\n\n\nclass GeoPoint(BaseModel):\n    lng: float = Field(..., description=\"WGS84 longitude\")\n    lat: float = Field(..., description=\"WGS84 latitude\")\n\n\nclass HotelSearchQuery(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"Normalized hotel search query passed to every HotelProvider.\"\"\"\n\n    city: str = Field(..., description=\"中文城市名，如 '北京'、'上海'\")\n    check_in: date\n    check_out: date\n    adults: int = Field(default=2, ge=1, le=10)\n    children: int = Field(default=0, ge=0, le=10)\n    rooms: int = Field(default=1, ge=1, le=5)\n\n    center: GeoPoint | None = Field(\n        default=None,\n        description=\"可选：搜索中心点（锚点），由 Agent 基于 POI 聚合得出\",\n    )\n    radius_km: float | None = Field(\n        default=None, ge=0, le=30, description=\"可选：以 center 为圆心的搜索半径\"\n    )\n\n    keyword: str | None = Field(default=None, description=\"可选：酒店名/关键词模糊匹配\")\n    min_price: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0)\n    max_price: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0)\n    star_rating: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=1, le=5, description=\"最低星级\")\n\n    @model_validator(mode=\"after\")\n    def _validate_dates(self) -> HotelSearchQuery:\n        if self.check_out <= self.check_in:\n            raise ValueError(\"check_out 必须晚于 check_in\")\n        if self.min_price is not None and self.max_price is not None:\n            if self.min_price > self.max_price:\n                raise ValueError(\"min_price 不能大于 max_price\")\n        return self\n\n    @property\n    def nights(self) -> int:\n        return (self.check_out - self.check_in).days\n\n\nclass ChannelOffer(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"同一酒店在某个渠道的某一房态报价，用于 Qunar 等聚合类 provider。\"\"\"\n\n    channel: str = Field(..., description=\"渠道名，如 ctrip / meituan / booking / qunar\")\n    room_type: str = Field(..., description=\"房型名\")\n    price: float = Field(..., description=\"折算到每晚的价格（人民币）\")\n    currency: str = Field(default=\"CNY\")\n    breakfast_included: bool = False\n    refundable: bool | None = None\n    deep_link: str | None = Field(default=None, description=\"该渠道对应的下单/跳转链接\")\n\n\nclass HotelOffer(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"搜索结果中的单个酒店卡片（已归一）。\"\"\"\n\n    provider: str = Field(..., description=\"产出该记录的 provider name，如 mock/booking/qunar\")\n    hotel_id: str = Field(..., description=\"provider 作用域内的酒店 ID\")\n    global_id: str | None = Field(\n        default=None,\n        description=\"跨渠道去重后的稳定 ID（registry 层生成，前端排序/收藏用）\",\n    )\n    name: str\n    brand: str | None = None\n    star_rating: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=1, le=5)\n    address: str | None = None\n    location: GeoPoint\n    thumbnail: str | None = Field(default=None, description=\"首图 URL\")\n\n    price_per_night: float = Field(..., description=\"归一后的每晚价格（人民币，含税前）\")\n    total_price: float = Field(..., description=\"归一后的总价（人民币）\")\n    currency: str = Field(default=\"CNY\")\n    breakfast_included: bool = False\n    refundable: bool | None = None\n\n    review_score: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0, le=10, description=\"官方评分 0-10\")\n    review_count: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=0)\n\n    distance_km: float | None = Field(\n        default=None, description=\"距搜索中心点距离（km），registry 层计算\"\n    )\n    tags: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)\n\n    deep_link: str | None = Field(default=None, description=\"下单/跳转链接（主渠道）\")\n\n\nclass HotelSearchResponse(BaseModel):\n    query: HotelSearchQuery\n    hotels: list[HotelOffer]\n    providers_used: list[str]\n    total: int\n    generated_at: datetime = Field(default_factory=datetime.utcnow)\n\n\nclass Review(BaseModel):\n    source: Literal[\"official\", \"rednote\", \"ctrip\", \"meituan\", \"booking\", \"other\"]\n    author: str | None = None\n    rating: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0, le=10)\n    content: str\n    posted_at: datetime | None = None\n    url: str | None = None\n\n\nclass  "contents": "\"\"\"ProviderRegistry —— 多 HotelProvider 并行 fan-out + 去重 + 归一 + 排序。\n\nMVP 阶段只启用 MockProvider；接入 Booking/Qunar 后，向 `build_default_registry`\n追加对应的 provider 实现即可，无需改 API 层。\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport asyncio\nimport hashlib\nimport logging\nimport math\nfrom collections.abc import Iterable\n\nfrom app.core.config import Settings, get_settings\nfrom app.providers.hotels.base import HotelProvider\nfrom app.providers.hotels.mock import MockHotelProvider\nfrom app.schemas import HotelDetail, HotelOffer, HotelSearchQuery\nfrom app.schemas.hotel import GeoPoint\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\n\nclass ProviderRegistry:\n    \"\"\"持有多个 HotelProvider，统一暴露 search/detail 接口。\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, providers: Iterable[HotelProvider]) -> None:\n        self._providers: dict[str, HotelProvider] = {p.name: p for p in providers}\n        if not self._providers:\n            raise ValueError(\"ProviderRegistry 至少需要一个 HotelProvider\")\n\n    @property\n    def names(self) -> list[str]:\n        return list(self._providers.keys())\n\n    def get(self, name: str) -> HotelProvider:\n        if name not in self._providers:\n            raise KeyError(f\"未注册的 HotelProvider: {name}\")\n        return self._providers[name]\n\n    async def search(self, query: HotelSearchQuery) -> list[HotelOffer]:\n        \"\"\"并行调用所有 provider，做跨渠道去重和距离计算。\"\"\"\n        tasks = {\n            name: asyncio.create_task(self._safe_search(provider, query))\n            for name, provider in self._providers.items()\n        }\n        results: list[HotelOffer] = []\n        for name, task in tasks.items():\n            offers = await task\n            logger.info(\"provider=%s 返回 %d 条结果\", name, len(offers))\n            results.extend(offers)\n\n        deduped = self._dedupe(results)\n        self._ensure_distance(deduped, query)\n        deduped.sort(\n            key=lambda h: (\n                h.distance_km if h.distance_km is not None else math.inf,\n                -(h.review_score or 0),\n                h.price_per_night,\n            )\n        )\n        return deduped\n\n    async def detail(self, provider_name: str, hotel_id: str) -> HotelDetail:\n        provider = self.get(provider_name)\n        return await provider.detail(hotel_id)\n\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # internals\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    async def _safe_search(\n        self, provider: HotelProvider, query: HotelSearchQuery\n    ) -> list[HotelOffer]:\n        try:\n            return await provider.search(query)\n        except Exception:  # 单个 provider 失败不影响整体\n            logger.exception(\"provider=%s search 失败，已降级为空列表\", provider.name)\n            return []\n\n    def _dedupe(self, offers: list[HotelOffer]) -> list[HotelOffer]:\n        \"\"\"跨渠道去重。\n\n        策略（MVP）：按 (归一化名称, 经纬度网格) 生成 global_id；同一 global_id\n        的多份报价保留价格最低者，把其他渠道名作为 tag 附加。\n        真实接入 Qunar 后再升级为品牌 ID + 名称模糊匹配。\n        \"\"\"\n        bucket: dict[str, HotelOffer] = {}\n        for o in offers:\n            gid = _build_global_id(o)\n            o.global_id = gid\n            prev = bucket.get(gid)\n            if prev is None:\n                bucket[gid] = o\n                continue\n            winner, loser = (o, prev) if o.price_per_night < prev.price_per_night else (prev, o)\n            alt_tag = f\"同酒店 {loser.provider} ¥{int(loser.price_per_night)}\"\n            if alt_tag not in winner.tags:\n                winner.tags.append(alt_tag)\n            bucket[gid] = winner\n        return list(bucket.values())\n\n    def _ensure_distance(self, offers: list[HotelOffer], query: HotelSearchQuery) -> None:\n        if query.center is None:\n            return\n        for o in offers:\n            if o.distance_km is None:\n                o.distance_km = round(_haversine_km(query.center, o.location), 2)\n\n\ndef _build_global_id(offer: HotelOffer) -> str:\n    norm_name = \"\".join(offer.name.split()).lower()\n    key = f\"{norm_name}|{round(offer.location.lng, 3)}|{round(offer.location.lat, 3)}\"\n    return hashlib.sha1(key.encode(\"utf-8\")).hexdigest()[:16]\n\n\ndef _haversine_km(a: GeoPoint, b: GeoPoint) -> float:\n    r = 6371.0\n    lat1, lat2 = math.radians(a.lat), math.radians(b.lat)\n    dlat = lat2 - lat1\n    dlng = math.radians(b.lng - a.lng)\n    h = math.sin(dlat / 2) ** 2 + math.cos(lat1) * math.cos(lat2) * math.sin(dlng / 2) ** 2\n    return 2 * r * math.asin(math.sqrt(h))\n\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# factory\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n_PROVIDER_FACTORIES: dict[str, callable] = {\n    \"mock\": MockHotelProvider,\n    # 'booking': BookingProvider,   # M3 接入\n    # 'qunar':   QunarProvider,     # M3 接入\n}\n\n\ndef build_default_registry(settings: Settings | None = None) -> ProviderRegistry:\n    settings = settings or get_settings()\n    providers: list[HotelProvider] = []\n    for name in settings.enabled_providers:\n        factory = _PROVIDER_FACTORIES.get(name)\n        if factory is None:\n            logger.warning(\"未知 HotelProvider '%s'，已跳过\", name)\n            continue\n        providers.append(factory())\n    if not providers:\n        logger.warning(\"未启用任何 HotelProvider，回退到 MockProvider\")\n        providers.append(MockHotelProvider())\n    return ProviderRegistry(providers)\n"
}

check_in).days, 1)\n    days: list[ItineraryDay] = []\n    for i in range(total):\n        d = check_in + timedelta(days=i)\n        days.append(\n            ItineraryDay(\n                day_index=i + 1,\n                date=d,\n                summary=f\"Day {i + 1}: {city}核心景点 + 地道美食体验\",\n                items=[\n                    ItineraryItem(\n                        time=\"09:00\",\n                        title=\"早餐 · 酒店自助\",\n                        description=\"含早套餐，能量满格\",\n                    ),\n                    ItineraryItem(\n                        time=\"10:00\",\n                        title=f\"{city}地标景点游览\",\n                        description=\"建议提前预约门票，游玩约 2 小时\",\n                        poi=f\"{city}著名景点\",\n                    ),\n                    ItineraryItem(\n                        time=\"12:30\",\n                        title=\"午餐 · 当地小吃\",\n                        description=\"推荐品尝当地特色\",\n                    ),\n                    ItineraryItem(\n                        time=\"14:30\",\n                        title=\"文化主题探索\",\n                        description=\"博物馆 / 老街 / 艺术区 任选其一\",\n                    ),\n                    ItineraryItem(\n                        time=\"18:30\",\n                        title=\"晚餐 · 精选餐厅\",\n                        description=\"根据酒店步行距离优选\",\n                    ),\n                    ItineraryItem(\n                        time=\"20:00\",\n                        title=\"夜景 & 返回酒店\",\n                        description=\"轻松漫步，结束一天行程\",\n                    ),\n                ],\n            )\n        )\n    return ItineraryResponse(city=city, days=days)\n"

 "contents": "\"\"\"FastAPI 应用入口。\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport logging\nfrom contextlib import asynccontextmanager\n\nfrom fastapi import FastAPI\nfrom fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware\n\nfrom app import __version__\nfrom app.api import api_router\nfrom app.core.config import get_settings\n\nlogging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format=\"%(asctime)s | %(levelname)s | %(name)s | %(message)s\")\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\n\n@asynccontextmanager\nasync def lifespan(app: FastAPI):\n    settings = get_settings()\n    logger.info(\n        \"Holiday Hotel Planner backend v%s starting in env=%s, providers=%s\",\n        __version__,\n        settings.app_env,\n        settings.enabled_providers,\n    )\n    yield\n    logger.info(\"Holiday Hotel Planner backend shutting down\")\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    settings = get_settings()\n    app = FastAPI(\n        title=\"Holiday Hotel Planner API\",\n        version=__version__,\n        lifespan=lifespan,\n    )\n\n    app.add_middleware(\n        CORSMiddleware,\n        allow_origins=settings.cors_origin_list,\n        allow_credentials=True,\n        allow_methods=[\"*\"],\n        allow_headers=[\"*\"],\n    )\n\n    app.include_router(api_router)\n\n    @app.get(\"/api/health\", tags=[\"health\"])\n    async def health() -> dict[str, str]:\n        return {\"status\": \"ok\", \"version\": __version__}\n\n    @app.get(\"/\", include_in_schema=False)\n    async def root() -> dict[str, str]:\n        return {\n            \"name\": \"Holiday Hotel Planner API\",\n            \"docs\": \"/docs\",\n            \"health\": \"/api/health\",\n        }\n\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()\n"
}

 "contents": "import clsx, { ClassValue } from 'clsx'\nimport { twMerge } from 'tailwind-merge'\n\nexport function cn(...inputs: ClassValue[]): string {\n  return twMerge(clsx(inputs))\n}\n\nexport function formatCNY(amount: number): string {\n  return `¥${Math.round(amount).toLocaleString('zh-CN')}`\n}\n\nexport function formatDate(d: string | Date): string {\n  const date = typeof d === 'string' ? new Date(d) : d\n  const y = date.getFullYear()\n  const m = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')\n  const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')\n  return `${y}-${m}-${day}`\n}\n\nexport function diffDays(from: string, to: string): number {\n  const a = new Date(from).getTime()\n  const b = new Date(to).getTime()\n  return Math.max(1, Math.round((b - a) / 86_400_000))\n}\n"
}

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\Hotel Manger\\frontend\\src\\api\\client.ts",
 "contents": "const BASE = (import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '').replace(/\\/+$/, '')\n\nexport interface RequestOptions extends RequestInit {\n  query?: Record<string, string | number | boolean | null | undefined>\n}\n\nfunction buildUrl(path: string, query?: RequestOptions['query']): string {\n  const url = new URL(`${BASE}${path}`, window.location.origin)\n  if (query) {\n    Object.entries(query).forEach(([k, v]) => {\n      if (v === undefined || v === null || v === '') return\n      url.searchParams.set(k, String(v))\n    })\n  }\n  return BASE ? url.toString() : `${url.pathname}${url.search}`\n}\n\nexport async function apiFetch<T>(path: string, options: RequestOptions = {}): Promise<T> {\n  const { query, headers, ...rest } = options\n  const url = buildUrl(path, query)\n\n  const response = await fetch(url, {\n    ...rest,\n    headers: {\n      'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n      Accept: 'application/json',\n      ...headers,\n    },\n  })\n\n  if (!response.ok) {\n    const text = await response.text().catch(() => '')\n    throw new Error(\n      `API ${rest.method ?? 'GET'} ${path} 失败：${response.status} ${response.statusText} ${text}`,\n    )\n  }\n  return (await response.json()) as T\n}\n"
}

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\Hotel Manger\\frontend\\src\\stores\\tripStore.ts",
 "contents": "import { create } from 'zustand'\nimport { persist } from 'zustand/middleware'\n\nexport interface TripState {\n  city: string\n  checkIn: string\n  checkOut: string\n  adults: number\n  rooms: number\n  mustVisit: string[]\n  budgetPerNight: number | null\n  preferStar: number | null\n  radiusKm: number\n\n  setField: <K extends keyof TripState>(key: K, value: TripState[K]) => void\n  addMustVisit: (poi: string) => void\n  removeMustVisit: (poi: string) => void\n  reset: () => void\n}\n\nconst defaultValues = {\n  city: '北京',\n  checkIn: todayOffset(7),\n  checkOut: todayOffset(9),\n  adults: 2,\n  rooms: 1,\n  mustVisit: ['故宫博物院', '什刹海'],\n  budgetPerNight: null as number | null,\n  preferStar: null as number | null,\n  radiusKm: 3,\n}\n\nfunction todayOffset(days: number): string {\n  const d = new Date()\n  d.setDate(d.getDate() + days)\n  return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10)\n}\n\nexport const useTripStore = create<TripState>()(\n  persist(\n    (set) => ({\n      ...defaultValues,\n      setField: (key, value) => set({ [key]: value } as Partial<TripState>),\n      addMustVisit: (poi) =>\n        set((state) => ({\n          mustVisit: state.mustVisit.includes(poi)\n            ? state.mustVisit\n            : [...state.mustVisit, poi],\n        })),\n      removeMustVisit: (poi) =>\n        set((state) => ({ mustVisit: state.mustVisit.filter((x) => x !== poi) })),\n      reset: () => set(defaultValues),\n    }),\n    { name: 'hotel-planner-trip' },\n  ),\n)\n"
}
```

 "contents": "import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'\n\nimport { searchHotels } from '@/api/hotels'\nimport type { HotelSearchResponse } from '@/api/types'\nimport { useTripStore } from '@/stores/tripStore'\n\nexport function useHotelSearch(enabled: boolean = true) {\n  const trip = useTripStore()\n  const params = {\n    city: trip.city,\n    check_in: trip.checkIn,\n    check_out: trip.checkOut,\n    adults: trip.adults,\n    rooms: trip.rooms,\n    max_price: trip.budgetPerNight ?? undefined,\n    star_rating: trip.preferStar ?? undefined,\n    radius_km: trip.radiusKm,\n  }\n\n  return useQuery<HotelSearchResponse>({\n    queryKey: ['hotels', params],\n    queryFn: () => searchHotels(params),\n    enabled,\n  })\n}\n"
}

 "contents": "import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react'\n\nimport { cn } from '@/lib/utils'\nimport type { HotelOffer } from '@/api/types'\n\nexport interface MapMarker {\n  id: string\n  lng: number\n  lat: number\n  label: string\n  highlight?: boolean\n}\n\nexport interface MapViewProps {\n  center?: { lng: number; lat: number }\n  markers?: MapMarker[]\n  radiusKm?: number\n  className?: string\n  onMarkerClick?: (id: string) => void\n}\n\nconst AMAP_KEY = import.meta.env.VITE_AMAP_JS_KEY as string | undefined\n\nexport function MapView({\n  center,\n  markers = [],\n  radiusKm,\n  className,\n  onMarkerClick,\n}: MapViewProps) {\n  const boxRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!AMAP_KEY || !boxRef.current) return\n    // 真实接入分支：引入高德 JS API。MVP 阶段先只做动态 script 加载占位，\n    // M2 再接 POI/marker/polyline 渲染。\n    const existing = document.getElementById('amap-jsapi-loader')\n    if (!existing) {\n      const script = document.createElement('script')\n      script.id = 'amap-jsapi-loader'\n      script.src = `https://webapi.amap.com/maps?v=2.0&key=${AMAP_KEY}`\n      script.async = true\n      document.body.appendChild(script)\n    }\n  }, [])\n\n  if (AMAP_KEY) {\n    return (\n      <div\n        ref={boxRef}\n        className={cn(\n          'relative h-full w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-100',\n          className,\n        )}\n      >\n        <div className=\"absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center text-sm text-slate-500\">\n          高德 JS API 已加载 · M2 接入地图实例渲染\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    )\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <MapPlaceholder\n      className={className}\n      center={center}\n      markers={markers}\n      radiusKm={radiusKm}\n      onMarkerClick={onMarkerClick}\n    />\n  )\n}\n\nfunction MapPlaceholder({\n  center,\n  markers,\n  radiusKm,\n  className,\n  onMarkerClick,\n}: MapViewProps) {\n  const bbox = useMemo(() => computeBBox(center, markers ?? []), [center, markers])\n\n  if (!center || !markers?.length) {\n    return (\n      <div\n        className={cn(\n          'flex h-full w-full items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-slate-50 text-sm text-slate-500',\n          className,\n        )}\n      >\n        暂无地图数据（请先触发搜索）\n      </div>\n    )\n  }\n\n  const size = 480\n  const { minLng, maxLng, minLat, maxLat } = bbox\n  const project = (lng: number, lat: number) => {\n    const x = ((lng - minLng) / (maxLng - minLng || 1)) * (size - 60) + 30\n    const y = size - (((lat - minLat) / (maxLat - minLat || 1)) * (size - 60) + 30)\n    return { x, y }\n  }\n\n  const c = project(center.lng, center.lat)\n\n  return (\n    <div\n      className={cn(\n        'relative h-full w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-gradient-to-br from-sky-50 to-slate-100',\n        className,\n      )}\n    >\n      <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${size} ${size}`} className=\"h-full w-full\">\n        <defs>\n          <pattern id=\"grid\" width=\"40\" height=\"40\" patternUnits=\"userSpaceOnUse\">\n            <path d=\"M 40 0 L 0 0 0 40\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"#e2e8f0\" strokeWidth=\"1\" />\n          </pattern>\n        </defs>\n        <rect width={size} height={size} fill=\"url(#grid)\" />\n\n        {radiusKm && (\n          <circle\n            cx={c.x}\n            cy={c.y}\n            r={Math.min(size / 2 - 30, radiusKm * 28)}\n            fill=\"rgba(14,165,233,0.08)\"\n            stroke=\"rgba(14,165,233,0.5)\"\n            strokeDasharray=\"4 4\"\n          />\n        )}\n\n        <circle cx={c.x} cy={c.y} r={7} fill=\"#0284c7\" stroke=\"#fff\" strokeWidth=\"2\" />\n        <text x={c.x + 10} y={c.y - 8} className=\"fill-brand-700\" fontSize=\"11\" fontWeight=\"600\">\n          锚点\n        </text>\n\n        {markers.map((m) => {\n          const p = project(m.lng, m.lat)\n          return (\n            <g\n              key={m.id}\n              className=\"cursor-pointer\"\n              onClick={() => onMarkerClick?.(m.id)}\n            >\n              <circle\n                cx={p.x}\n                cy={p.y}\n                r={m.highlight ? 8 : 6}\n                fill={m.highlight ? '#f97316' : '#fff'}\n                stroke={m.highlight ? '#ea580c' : '#0284c7'}\n                strokeWidth=\"2\"\n              />\n              <text\n                x={p.x + 10}\n                y={p.y + 4}\n                className=\"fill-slate-700\"\n                fontSize=\"10\"\n              >\n                {m.label}\n              </text>\n            </g>\n          )\n        })}\n      </svg>\n      <div className=\"pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-3 rounded-md bg-white/80 px-2 py-1 text-[11px] text-slate-600 backdrop-blur\">\n        Map Preview · 未配置 VITE_AMAP_JS_KEY，展示 SVG 占位图\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\nfunction computeBBox(\n  center: { lng: number; lat: number } | undefined,\n  markers: MapMarker[],\n) {\n  const points = [...markers]\n  if (center) points.push({ id: 'center', lng: center.lng, lat: center.lat, label: '' })\n  if (points.length === 0) {\n    return { minLng: 0, maxLng: 1, minLat: 0, maxLat: 1 }\n  }\n  const lngs = points.map((p) => p.lng)\n  const lats = points.map((p) => p.lat)\n  const minLng = Math.min(...lngs)\n  const maxLng = Math.max(...lngs)\n  const minLat = Math.min(...lats)\n  const maxLat = Math.max(...lats)\n  const padLng = (maxLng - minLng) * 0.2 || 0.01\n  const padLat = (maxLat - minLat) * 0.2 || 0.01\n  return {\n    minLng: minLng - padLng,\n    maxLng: maxLng + padLng,\n    minLat: minLat - padLat,\n    maxLat: maxLat + padLat,\n  }\n}\n\nexport function offerToMarker(offer: HotelOffer, highlight = false): MapMarker {\n  return {\n    id: `${offer.provider}:${offer.hotel_id}`,\n    lng: offer.location.lng,\n    lat: offer.location.lat,\n    label: offer.name,\n    highlight,\n  }\n}\n"
}

 "contents": "import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'\n\nimport type { HotelOffer } from '@/api/types'\nimport { cn, formatCNY } from '@/lib/utils'\n\ninterface HotelCardProps {\n  offer: HotelOffer\n  compact?: boolean\n  active?: boolean\n  onHover?: (id: string | null) => void\n}\n\nexport function HotelCard({ offer, compact = false, active = false, onHover }: HotelCardProps) {\n  const detailPath = `/hotel/${offer.provider}/${encodeURIComponent(offer.hotel_id)}`\n  return (\n    <Link\n      to={detailPath}\n      onMouseEnter={() => onHover?.(`${offer.provider}:${offer.hotel_id}`)}\n      onMouseLeave={() => onHover?.(null)}\n      className={cn(\n        'group flex gap-4 rounded-xl border bg-white p-3 shadow-card transition hover:border-brand-300 hover:shadow-md',\n        active ? 'border-orange-300 ring-2 ring-orange-200' : 'border-slate-100',\n      )}\n    >\n      <div\n        className={cn(\n          'overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-slate-100',\n          compact ? 'h-20 w-28 shrink-0' : 'h-28 w-40 shrink-0',\n        )}\n      >\n        {offer.thumbnail ? (\n          <img\n            src={offer.thumbnail}\n            alt={offer.name}\n            className=\"h-full w-full object-cover transition group-hover:scale-105\"\n            loading=\"lazy\"\n          />\n        ) : (\n          <div className=\"grid h-full w-full place-items-center text-xs text-slate-400\">无图</div>\n        )}\n      </div>\n      <div className=\"flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col justify-between gap-1.5\">\n        <div className=\"min-w-0\">\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n            <h3 className=\"truncate text-base font-semibold text-slate-900\">{offer.name}</h3>\n            {offer.star_rating && (\n              <span className=\"chip shrink-0\">{offer.star_rating}★</span>\n            )}\n          </div>\n          {offer.address && (\n            <p className=\"truncate text-xs text-slate-500\">{offer.address}</p>\n          )}\n          {!compact && (\n            <div className=\"mt-1 flex flex-wrap gap-1\">\n              {offer.tags.slice(0, 4).map((t) => (\n                <span key={t} className=\"chip bg-slate-50 text-slate-600 ring-slate-200\">\n                  {t}\n                </span>\n              ))}\n            </div>\n          )}\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"flex items-end justify-between\">\n          <div className=\"text-xs text-slate-500\">\n            {offer.review_score ? (\n              <>\n                <span className=\"font-semibold text-amber-600\">{offer.review_score}</span>\n                <span> · {offer.review_count?.toLocaleString() ?? 0} 条评价</span>\n              </>\n            ) : (\n              <span>暂无评分</span>\n            )}\n            {offer.distance_km != null && (\n              <span className=\"ml-2 text-slate-400\">距锚点 {offer.distance_km} km</span>\n            )}\n          </div>\n          <div className=\"text-right\">\n            <div className=\"text-lg font-bold text-brand-600\">\n              {formatCNY(offer.price_per_night)}\n            </div>\n            <div className=\"text-[10px] text-slate-400\">起 / 晚</div>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </Link>\n  )\n}\n"
}

(\n        <p className=\"text-sm text-slate-500\">{empty ?? '暂无数据'}</p>\n      ) : (\n        <ul className=\"space-y-3\">\n          {reviews.map((r, idx) => (\n            <li\n              key={idx}\n              className=\"rounded-lg border border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/50 p-3\"\n            >\n              <div className=\"mb-1 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-500\">\n                <span>{r.author ?? '匿名用户'}</span>\n                {r.rating != null && (\n                  <span className=\"font-semibold text-amber-600\">★ {r.rating}</span>\n                )}\n              </div>\n              <p className=\"text-sm leading-relaxed text-slate-700\">{r.content}</p>\n              {r.posted_at && (\n                <p className=\"mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-400\">\n                  {new Date(r.posted_at).toLocaleDateString('zh-CN')}\n                </p>\n              )}\n            </li>\n          ))}\n        </ul>\n      )}\n    </section>\n  )\n}\n"

 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\Hotel Manger\\frontend\\src\\components\\DateRangePicker.tsx",
 "contents": "interface DateRangePickerProps {\n  checkIn: string\n  checkOut: string\n  onChange: (next: { checkIn: string; checkOut: string }) => void\n}\n\nexport function DateRangePicker({ checkIn, checkOut, onChange }: DateRangePickerProps) {\n  const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"grid grid-cols-2 gap-3\">\n      <div>\n        <label className=\"label\">入住日期</label>\n        <input\n          type=\"date\"\n          className=\"input\"\n          min={today}\n          value={checkIn}\n          onChange={(e) => {\n            const newIn = e.target.value\n            let newOut = checkOut\n            if (new Date(newIn) >= new Date(checkOut)) {\n              const next = new Date(newIn)\n              next.setDate(next.getDate() + 1)\n              newOut = next.toISOString().slice(0, 10)\n            }\n            onChange({ checkIn: newIn, checkOut: newOut })\n          }}\n        />\n      </div>\n      <div>\n        <label className=\"label\">离店日期</label>\n        <input\n          type=\"date\"\n          className=\"input\"\n          min={checkIn}\n          value={checkOut}\n          onChange={(e) => onChange({ checkIn, checkOut: e.target.value })}\n        />\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n"
}
```

}

[_HOLIDAY_CN_NAMES.get(n, n) for n in holiday_names]\n        for name in holiday_names:\n            max_mult = max(max_mult, _HOLIDAY_PRICE_MULTIPLIERS.get(name, 1.5))\n            suggested_advance pct_high = int((max_mult - 1) * 100)\n        reasons.append(\n            f\"入住区间含国家法定假日（{'、'.join(cn_names)}），\"\n            f\"酒店价格预计上涨 {pct_low}%～{pct_high}%。\"\n        )\n\n    # 周末高峰\n    if  "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\Hotel Manger\\backend\\app\\api\\holidays.py",
 "contents": "\"\"\"/api/holidays —— 节假日查询与涨价预警。\n\n- `GET /range` 返回日期区间内每天的节假日/周末/调休状态，前端日期选择器据此高亮。\n- `GET /peak`  基于入住区间综合判断涨价等级与建议提前天数。\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom datetime import date\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query\nfrom pydantic import BaseModel\n\nfrom app.services.holiday import (\n    DayInfo,\n    PeakWarning,\n    classify_range,\n    peak_warning,\n)\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/holidays\", tags=[\"holidays\"])\n\n\nclass HolidayRangeResponse(BaseModel):\n    start: date\n    end: date\n    days: list[DayInfo]\n\n\n@router.get(\"/range\", response_model=HolidayRangeResponse)\nasync def holiday_range(\n    start: Annotated[date, Query(..., description=\"起始日期（含），YYYY-MM-DD\")],\n    end: Annotated[date, Query(..., description=\"结束日期（含），YYYY-MM-DD\")],\n) -> HolidayRangeResponse:\n    try:\n        days = classify_range(start, end)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(exc)) from exc\n    return HolidayRangeResponse(start=start, end=end, days=days)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/peak\", response_model=PeakWarning)\nasync def holiday_peak(\n    check_in: Annotated[date, Query(..., description=\"入住日期\")],\n    check_out: Annotated[date, Query(..., description=\"离店日期\")],\n) -> PeakWarning:\n    try:\n        return peak_warning(check_in, check_out)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(exc)) from exc\n"
}

 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\Hotel Manger\\frontend\\src\\hooks\\useHolidays.ts",
 "contents": "import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'\n\nimport {\n  fetchHolidayRange,\n  fetchPeakWarning,\n  type DayInfo,\n  type HolidayRangeResponse,\n  type PeakWarning,\n} from '@/api/holidays'\n\nconst STALE = 1000 * 60 * 60 * 6\n\nexport function useHolidayRange(start: string, end: string, enabled = true) {\n  return useQuery<HolidayRangeResponse>({\n    queryKey: ['holiday-range', start, end],\n    queryFn: () => fetchHolidayRange(start, end),\n    enabled: enabled && Boolean(start && end) && start <= end,\n    staleTime: STALE,\n  })\n}\n\nexport function usePeakWarning(checkIn: string, checkOut: string, enabled = true) {\n  return useQuery<PeakWarning>({\n    queryKey: ['peak-warning', checkIn, checkOut],\n    queryFn: () => fetchPeakWarning(checkIn, checkOut),\n    enabled: enabled && Boolean(checkIn && checkOut) && checkIn < checkOut,\n    staleTime: STALE,\n  })\n}\n\nexport function dayLookup(range: HolidayRangeResponse | undefined) {\n  const map = new Map<string, DayInfo>()\n  if (!range) return map\n  for (const d of range.days) map.set(d.date, d)\n  return map\n}\n"
}

'法定假日')\n  if (info.is_makeup_workday) parts.push('调休上班')\n  else if (info.is_weekend) parts.push('周末')\n  return parts.join(' · ')\n}\n\nfunction toISO(d: Date): string {\n  const y = d.getFullYear()\n  const m = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')\n  const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')\n  return `${y}-${m}-${day}`\n}\n\nfunction buildMonthCells(cursor: Date): (string | null)[] {\n  const first = new Date(cursor.getFullYear(), cursor.getMonth(), 1)\n  const last = new Date(cursor.getFullYear(), cursor.getMonth() + 1, 0)\n  const jsDay = first.getDay() // 0 = Sunday\n  const startOffset = (jsDay + 6) % 7 // 将周一视为一周起点\n  const cells: (string | null)[] = []\n  for (let i = 0; i < startOffset; i += 1) cells.push(null)\n  for (let d = 1; d <= last.getDate(); d += 1) {\n    const date = new Date(cursor.getFullYear(), cursor.getMonth(), d)\n    cells.push(toISO(date))\n  }\n  while (cells.length % 7 !== 0) cells.push(null)\n  return cells\n}\n"

os\nimport re\nfrom contextlib import AsyncExitStack\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom app.core.config import Settings\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\n_ENV_VAR_RE = re.compile(r\"\\$\\{([A-Z0-9_]+)\\}\")\n\n\nclass MCPUnavailable(RuntimeError):\n    \"\"\"MCP 不可用：未安装 SDK、配置缺失、子进程启动失败等。\"\"\"\n\n\nclass MCPToolError(RuntimeError):\n    \"\"\"MCP tool 调用返回错误内容。\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _resolve_env(raw: dict[str, str] | None, settings: Settings) -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"把 `${AMAP_KEY}` 这种占位符替换为 Settings 中的值，其他变量走真实 env。\"\"\"\n    if not raw:\n        return {}\n    setting_map = {\n        \"AMAP_KEY\": settings.amap_key,\n    }\n    resolved: dict[str, str] = {}\n    for k, v in raw.items():\n        if not isinstance(v, str):\n            resolved[k] = str(v)\n            continue\n\n        def repl(match: re.Match[str]) -> str:\n            key = match.group(1)\n            return setting_map.get(key) or os.environ.get(key, \"\")\n\n        resolved[k] = _ENV_VAR_RE.sub(repl, v)\n    return resolved\n\n\ndef load_servers_config(path: Path | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"读取仓库根下的 `mcp/servers.json`（支持 $comment 占位注释）。\"\"\"\n    if path is None:\n        here = Path(__file__).resolve()\n        root = here.parents[4]  # .../app/providers/maps/mcp_client.py → 仓库根\n        path = root / \"mcp\" / data.get(\"mcpServers\") or {}\n    return servers\n\n\nclass MCPClient:\n    \"\"\"一个 MCP server 对应一个 MCPClient，内部复用同一个 stdio session。\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        name: str,\n        command: str,\n        args: list[str],\n        env: dict[str, str],\n    ) -> None:\n        self.name = name\n        self._command = command\n        self._args = args\n        self._env = env\n        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()\n        self._stack: AsyncExitStack | None = None\n        self._session: Any | None = None  # mcp.ClientSession\n        self._tools: list[str] | None = None\n\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # factory\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    @classmethod\n    def from_config(cls, name: str, settings: Settings) -> \"MCPClient\":\n        servers = load_servers_config()\n        if name not in servers:\n            raise MCPUnavailable(f\"未在 mcp/servers.json 中找到 server: {name}\")\n        cfg = servers[name]\n        if cfg.get(\"disabled\"):\n            raise MCPUnavailable(f\"MCP server '{name}' 已在配置中禁用\")\n        if cfg.get(\"transport\", \"stdio\") != \"stdio\":\n            raise MCPUnavailable(f\"暂不支持 {cfg['transport']} transport（仅 stdio）\")\n        command = cfg.get(\"command\")\n        args = cfg.get(\"args\") or []\n        if not command:\n            raise MCPUnavailable(f\"server '{name}' 缺少 command\")\n        env = _resolve_env(cfg.get(\"env\"), settings)\n        return cls(name=name, command=command, args=args, env=env)\n\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # lifecycle\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    async def _ensure_session(self) -> Any:\n        if self._session is not None:\n            return self._session\n        async with self._lock:\n            if self._session is not None:\n                return self._session\n  params = StdioServerParameters(\n                    command=self._command,\n                    args=self._args,\n                    env={**os.environ, **self._env},\n                )\n session.initialize()\n            except Exception as exc:\n                await stack.aclose()\n                raise MCPUnavailable(\n                    f\"启动 MCP server '{self.name}' 失败：{exc}\"\n                ) from exc\n\n            self._stack = stack\n            self._session = session\n            try:\n                tools = await session.list_tools()\n                self._tools = not None:\n                try:\n                    await self._stack.aclose()\n                finally:\n                    self._stack = None\n                    self._session = None\n  async def list_tool_names(self) -> list[str]:\n        await self._ensure_session()\n        return list(self._tools or [])\n\n    async def call_tool(self, tool: str, args: dict[str, Any]) -> Any:\n type: ignore[override]\n        return await self._dispatch(\n            \"geocode\", lambda c: c.geocode(address, city=city)\n        )\n\n    async def around_search(self, center, radius_m=3000, keywords=None):  # type: ignore[override]\n        return await self._dispatch(\n            \"around_search\",\n            lambda c: c.around_search(center, radius_m=radius_m, keywords=keywords),\n        )\n\n    async def direction_driving(self, origin, destination):  # type: ignore[override]\n        return await self._dispatch(\n            \"direction_driving\", lambda c: c.direction_driving(origin, destination)\n        )\n\n    async def _dispatch(self, name: str, fn):\n        if not self._primary_disabled:\n            try:\n                return await fn(self._primary)\n            except MCPUnavailable as exc:\n                logger.warning(\"MCP 调用 %s 失败，永久回退 HTTP：%s\", name, exc)\n                self._primary_disabled = True\n            except Exception as exc:  # ### 🤖 Agent

I'm reconsidering the approach — the `__wrapped__` attribute hack feels inelegant. Instead, I'll track which maps client instances have actually been constructed and clean them up on shutdown, rather than relying on lazy initialization tricks. This way `get_maps_client` can construct the client directly when needed, and if no API key is configured, it'll handle that case appropriately.

For the shutdown sequence, I can check whether the client was ever instantiated using `lru_cache`'s introspection, and if it was, retrieve it and call the async cleanup method — the cache ensures this is safe to do multiple times.

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\Hotel Manger\\backend\\app\\services\\cache.py",
 "contents": "\"\"\"轻量级异步 TTL 缓存。\n\n用于酒店 provider 的搜索/详情结果缓存，避免热门城市频繁打爆上游。\nMVP 阶段用内存实现；后续切 Redis 时只需换一个同协议的实现。\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport asyncio\nimport time\nfrom typing import Any, Generic, TypeVar\n\nT = TypeVar(\"T\")\n\n\nclass TTLCache(Generic[T]):\n    \"\"\"进程内 TTL 缓存，协程安全。\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, ttl_seconds: int, *, max_size: int = 512) -> None:\n        self._ttl = max(0, int(ttl_seconds))\n        self._max_size = max(1, int(max_size))\n        self._store: dict[str, tuple[float, T]] = {}\n        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()\n\n    async def get(self, key: str) -> T | None:\n        if self._ttl == 0:\n            return None\n        async with self._lock:\n            record = self._store.get(key)\n            if record is None:\n                return None\n            expires, value = record\n            if time.time() > expires:\n                self._store.pop(key, None)\n                return None\n            return value\n\n    async def set(self, key: str, value: T) -> None:\n        if self._ttl == 0:\n            return\n        async with self._lock:\n            if len(self._store) >= self._max_size:\n                self._evict_expired_locked()\n                if len(self._store) >= self._max_size:\n                    # 淘汰最旧的一个\n                    oldest = min(self._store.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1][0])\n                    self._store.pop(oldest[0], None)\n            self._store[key] = (time.time() + self._ttl, value)\n\n    async def clear(self) -> None:\n        async with self._lock:\n            self._store.clear()\n\n    def _evict_expired_locked(self) -> None:\n        now = time.time()\n        expired = [k for k, (exp, _) in self._store.items() if exp < now]\n        for k in expired:\n            self._store.pop(k, None)\n"
}

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\Hotel Manger\\backend\\app\\services\\currency.py",
 "contents": "\"\"\"极简币种归一：将外币折算成人民币（CNY）。\n\nMVP 不打外汇实时汇率，使用内置固定快照；后续可替换为\n`httpx` 调用 openexchangerates / ecb / 聚合支付内部汇率接口。\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom datetime import date\n\n# 2026 年 Q1 参考中间价（人民币兑外币），可随时更新\n_CNY_PER_UNIT: dict[str, float] = {\n    \"CNY\": 1.0,\n    \"HKD\": 0.93,\n    \"USD\": 7.25,\n    \"EUR\": 7.85,\n    \"GBP\": 9.15,\n    \"JPY\": 0.050,\n    \"KRW\": 0.0053,\n    \"TWD\": 0.23,\n    \"SGD\": 5.40,\n    \"AUD\": 4.80,\n    \"THB\": 0.21,\n    \"MYR\": 1.55,\n}\n\n\ndef to_cny(amount: float, currency: str | None) -> float:\n    \"\"\"把 amount (currency) 折算成人民币。未知币种保守按 1:1 返回并忽略。\"\"\"\n    if amount is None:\n        return 0.0\n    if not currency:\n        return float(amount)\n    rate = _CNY_PER_UNIT.get(currency.upper())\n    if rate is None:\n        return float(amount)\n    return round(float(amount) * rate, 2)\n\n\ndef currency_as_cny(amount: float, currency: str | None, *, at: date | None = None) -> float:\n    \"\"\"带日期参数的公开入口，便于后续接真实汇率接口时替换。\"\"\"\n    _ = at\n    return to_cny(amount, currency)\n"
}

item.get(\"price\") or {}\n        currency = price_block.get(\"currency\") or \"CNY\"\n        total_price_raw = _as_float(\n            price_block.get(\"total_price\")\n            or price_block.get(\"amount\")\n            or price_block.get(\"per_stay\")\n        )\n        per_night_raw = _as_float(\n            price_block.get(\"amount_per_night\") or price_block.get(\"per_night\")\n        )\n\n        nights = _estimate_nights(item, query)\n        if total_price_raw is None and per_night_raw is not None:\n            total_price_raw = per_night_raw * nights\n        if total_price_raw is None:\n            return None\n        if per_night_raw is None:\n            per_night_raw = total_price_raw / max(1, nights)\n\n        total_price_cny = to_cny(total_price_raw, currency)\n        per_night_cny = to_cny(per_night_raw, currency)\n\n        hotel_id = str(item.get(\"id\") or item.get(\"accommodation_id\"))\n        return HotelOffer(\n            provider=self.name,\n            hotel_id=hotel_id,\n            name=item.get(\"name\") or item.get(\"accommodation_name\") or hotel_id,\n            brand=_as_optional_str(item.get(\"brand\")),\n            star_rating=_as_optional_int(item.get(\"class\") or item.get(\"star_rating\")),\n            address=_as_optional_str(loc.get(\"address\") or item.get(\"address\")),\n            location=GeoPoint(lng=lng, lat=lat),\n            thumbnail=_first_photo(item),\n            price_per_night=round(per_night_cny, 2),\n            total_price=round(total_price_cny, 2),\n            currency=\"CNY\",\n            breakfast_included=bool(item.get(\"breakfast_included\")),\n            refundable=_as_optional_bool(item.get(\"refundable\")),\n            review_score=_as_optional_float(item.get(\"review_score\")),\n            review_count=_as_optional_int(item.get(\"review_count\")),\n            tags=[t for t in (item.get(\"tags\") or []) if isinstance(t, str)],\n            deep_link=self._build_deep_link(hotel_id, None),\n        )\n\n    def _build_deep_link(self, hotel_id: str, room_id: str | None) -> str:\n        params: dict[str, str] = {\n            \"aid\": self._affiliate_id or \"0\",\n            \"no_rooms\": \"1\",\n        }\n        if room_id:\n            params[\"room\"] = str(room_id)\n        base = f\"https://www.booking.com/hotel/cn/{hotel_id}.zh-cn.html\"\n        return f\"{base}?{urlencode(params)}\"\n\n    def _apply_client_filters(\n        self, offers: list[HotelOffer], query: HotelSearchQuery\n    ) -> list[HotelOffer]:\n        out = offers\n        if query.min_price is not None:\n            out = [o for o in out if o.price_per_night >= query.min_price]\n        if query.max_price is not None:\n            out = [o for o in out if o.price_per_night <= query.max_price]\n        if query.star_rating is not None:\n            out = [o for o in out if (o.star_rating or 0) >= query.star_rating]\n        if query.keyword:\n            kw = query.keyword.lower()\n            out = [o for o in out if kw in o.name.lower() or kw in (o.brand or \"\").lower()]\n        return out\n\n    def _search_cache_key(self, q: HotelSearchQuery) str(q.rooms),\n        ]\n        if q.center is not None:\n            parts.append(f\"{q.center.lng:.4f},{q.center.lat:.4f}\")\n        if q.radius_km is not None:\n            parts.append(f\"r={q.radius_km}\")\n        return \"|\".join(parts)\n\n    def _parse_id(self, raw: str) -> int | str:\n        try:\n            return int(raw)\n        except (TypeError, int:\n    if query is not None:\n        return max(1, query.nights)\n    return 1\n\n\ndef _as_float(v: Any) -> float | None:\n    if v is None:\n        return None\n    try:\n        return float(v)\n    except (TypeError, ValueError):\n        return None\n\n\ndef _as_optional_int(v: Any) -> int | None:\n    f = _as_float(v)\n    if f is None:\n        return None\n    return int(f)\n\n\ndef _as_optional_float(v: Any) -> float | None:\n    return _as_float(v)\n\n\ndef _as_optional_str(v: Any) -> str | None:\n    if v is None:\n        return None\n    s = str(v).strip()\n    return s or None\n\n\ndef _as_optional_bool(v: Any) -> bool | None:\n    if v is None:\n        return None\n    if isinstance(v, bool):\n        return v\n    if isinstance(v, str):\n        lower = v.strip().lower()\n        if lower in (\"true\", \"yes\", \"1\"):\n            return True\n        if lower in (\"false\", \"no\", \"0\"):\n            return False\n    return None\n\n\ndef There's a special consideration here—Qunar aggregates multiple channels for the same hotel, so I need to handle consolidating those multi-channel quotes into a single hotel entry.

The key challenge is that Qunar returns multiple room types and multiple booking channels per hotel, so I'll flatten this into one HotelOffer per hotel using the lowest price as the primary option, while preserving all the channel information in the HotelDetail for UI comparison. For authentication, Qunar's CPS API uses MD5 signing where I sort parameters alphabetically and hash them with the app secret sandwiched on both sides. I'll design the QunarProvider class with configurable app credentials, base URL, HTTP client, and cache settings, then implement the three endpoints with proper signing and make it mockable for testing.

Now let me write tests for the Qunar provider:

 I'm considering how the deduplication logic should work when the Registry combines data from multiple sources like Qunar, Booking, and Mock providers. Since Qunar already aggregates across channels, I need to ensure that when Booking returns the same hotel that Qunar has already indexed through Ctrip, they properly merge rather than create duplicates.

The current implementation uses normalized name plus rounded latitude/longitude coordinates as the dedup key, which should handle cross-channel matching. The plan mentions upgrading this to brand-aware fuzzy matching, but for the MVP I think the location-based approach is sufficient—I'll enhance the name normalization to strip common Chinese suffixes like "酒店" and "店" to catch more variations, while keeping the 3-decimal precision on coordinates for roughly 111-meter accuracy.

## 1. `holiday-module`（节假日 + 涨价预警）

- `backend/app/services/holiday.py` — 基于 `chinese_calendar` 1.11（升级以支持 2026）区分四种日类型：法定假日 / 普通周末 / 调休上班 / 工作日；`peak_warning()` 综合法定假日系数（春节 2.4×、国庆 2.2×、劳动节 1.8×…）+ 周末 + 春运窗口，给出 `normal / warn / peak` 三档与"建议提前 N 天"。
- `backend/app/api/holidays.py` — `GET /api/holidays/range` 返回区间每日分类，`GET /api/holidays/peak` 返回涨价预警。

**前端**
- `frontend/src/api/holidays.ts` + `hooks/useHolidays.ts` — TanStack Query 封装，6h staleTime。
- `components/DateRangePicker.tsx` 重写：内嵌月历，法定假日红字 + 中文名、周末玫瑰色、调休"班"角标；选中后显示三色 `PeakBanner`（原因列表 + 建议提前天数 + 预期价格系数）。

**测试**：`tests/test_holiday.py`（12 项）——覆盖每种日类型、国庆高峰、周末中档、工作日正常、API 参数校验。

## 2. `amap-mcp`（高德 MCP 客户端）

**后端**
- `providers/maps/mcp_client.py` — 通用 `MCPClient`（stdio），读取 `mcp/servers.json`，`${AMAP_KEY}` 环境变量替换，懒启动 + `asyncio.Lock` 线程安全，未安装 `mcp` SDK / 启动失败时抛 `MCPUnavailable`。
- `providers/maps/amap_http.py` — `AmapHttpClient`，直连 `restapi.amap.com/v3`，解析高德"空字段返回空 list"的常见坑。
- `providers/maps/amap_mcp.py` — `AmapMCPClient` 对齐 `maps_geo` / `maps_around_search` / `maps_direction_driving`。
- `providers/maps/factory.py` — 三种 `AMAP_TRANSPORT` 模式：`auto`（首选 MCP、失败降级 HTTP）/ `mcp` / `http`；组合客户端 `CompositeAmapClient` 会记录首次失败后永久切到 HTTP。
- `api/maps.py` — `GET /api/maps/geocode|around_search|directions` 便于 Agent + 前端调试。
- `main.py` lifespan 在关机时释放 stdio 子进程。

**测试**：`tests/test_maps.py`（13 项）——`httpx.MockTransport` 拦截高德响应，验证解析、错误处理、环境占位符、factory 路由、API 注入。

## 3. `booking-provider`（Booking Demand API）

**后端**
- `services/cache.py` — 协程安全的 `TTLCache[T]`（MVP 用内存，接口同步 Redis 时可替换）。
- `services/currency.py` — 固定汇率快照（`to_cny`），覆盖 USD/EUR/HKD/JPY/KRW 等。
- `providers/hotels/booking.py` — `BookingAffiliateProvider`：Bearer token + `/accommodations/{search,details,reviews}`，按 (city, dates, rooms) 缓存未过滤的原始结果，读取时再按 `min/max_price` / `star_rating` / `keyword` 过滤；deep_link 自动拼 `aid=<AFFILIATE_ID>`；401/403/429 抛结构化错误。
- `registry.py` 注册了 `booking` 工厂；未配置 `BOOKING_API_TOKEN` 时工厂会 `ValueError`，Registry 捕获后记录 warning 并跳过该 provider。

**测试**：`tests/test_booking_provider.py`（12 项）——验证价格归一（2560 CNY 总价 / 2 晚 = 1280 每晚；USD 150 → CNY 543.75）、过滤器、缓存命中、Bearer + payload、401/429、detail 多房型 channels、reviews 降级。

## 4. `qunar-provider`（去哪儿 CPS 聚合）

**后端**
- `providers/hotels/qunar.py` — `QunarProvider`：
  - **同酒店多房态多渠道拍平**（plan 核心要求）：`_expand_channels` 同时支持 A 形态 `raw.channels[]` 与 B 形态 `raw.rooms[].prices[]`，去重后取最低价作为 `HotelOffer.price_per_night`，全部渠道保留到 `HotelDetail.channels[]` 供前端比价。
  - 多渠道时在 tags 加"聚合 N 个渠道报价"标注。
  - `_sign` 实现去哪儿 CPS 的 MD5 签名：`MD5(secret + sortedKV + secret)`，自动带 `appKey` + `timestamp`。
  - 渠道名归一化：携程/xiecheng → ctrip，美团 → meituan，飞猪 → fliggy 等；`Review.source` 映射到 schema 允许的枚举。
- `registry.py` 注册 `qunar` 工厂，同样按 app_key + secret 存在才注册。

**测试**：`tests/test_qunar_provider.py`（10 项）——压平取最低价（亚朵 3 渠道，取 meituan 650）、MD5 签名验证、detail 保留全部 channels、errcode/401 错误、缓存命中，**并重点验证跨 provider 去重**：Mock + Qunar 各自返回同一家酒店（同名 + 同坐标） → Registry `_dedupe` 正确合并为 1 条，并把 mock 的 780 作为 "同酒店 mock ¥780" tag 保留。

## 其它配套改动
- `backend/requirements.txt` 版本改为范围约束，新增 `mcp`、升级 `chinese-calendar` 1.11；`fastapi` 升到 0.136 以匹配 mcp 依赖的 starlette 1.0。
- `backend/app/core/config.py` 新增 `booking_api_token / booking_api_base_url / booking_cache_ttl_seconds / qunar_api_base_url / qunar_cache_ttl_seconds`。
- `.env.example`（根 + backend）补齐新变量与 `AMAP_TRANSPORT=auto`。

\"peak\"]\n    reasons: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)\n    holiday_names: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)\n    weekend_nights: int = 0\n    legal_holiday_nights: int = 0\n    expected_price_multiplier: float = 1.0\n    suggested_advance_days: int = 7\n\n\nclass POIPreview(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"前端在规划过程中看到的 POI 卡片（从 MapsClient POI 收窄出来）。\"\"\"\n\n    id: str\n    name: str\n    location: GeoPoint\n    address: str | None = None\n    type: str | None = None\n    source: Literal[\"must_visit\", \"around\", \"keyword\"] = \"around\"\n\n\nclass AnchorDecision(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"`cluster_anchor` 的决策结果。\"\"\"\n\n    center: GeoPoint\n    radius_km: float = Field(ge=0.1)\n    explanation: str = Field(\n        default=\"\", description=\"AI/启发式给出的锚点选择理由，供 UI 展示\"\n    )\n    poi_count: int = 0\n\n\nclass RankedHotel(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"`rank_and_explain` 节点产出的排序项。\"\"\"\n\n    offer: HotelOffer\n    score: float = commute_minutes: int | None = Field(\n        default=None, description=\"到锚点的估算通勤时长（分钟）\"\n    )\n\n\nclass PlanItineraryItem(BaseModel):\n    time: str\n    title: str\n    description: str\n    poi: str | None = None\n\n\nclass PlanItineraryDay(BaseModel):\n    day_index: int\n    date: date\n    summary: str\n    items: list[PlanItineraryItem]\n\n\nclass PlanItinerary(BaseModel):\n    city: str\n    days: list[PlanItineraryDay]\n\n\nclass PlanResult(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"规划完成后的完整快照，前端 `done` 事件里拿到它即可直接渲染 Itinerary 页。\"\"\"\n\n    request: PlanRequest\n    intent: ParsedIntent\n    peak: \"error\",\n]\n\n\nclass PlanEvent(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"SSE 单帧事件。\n\n    - `node_start` / `node_end` 带 `phase`；\n    - `node_end` 还会带该节点产出的结构化 `data`（具体 schema 见下方 shape 字段）；\n    - `done` 事件的  "contents": "\"\"\"OpenAI 兼容 Chat Completions 客户端。\n\n设计：\n- 直接用 httpx 打 `{base_url}/chat/completions`，不依赖 openai SDK，减少依赖体积；\n- 默认目标是 Kimi K2.5（Moonshot，`base_url=https://api.moonshot.cn/v1`），\n  但只要请求体符合 OpenAI chat 协议，就能无缝切换 DeepSeek / Qwen / OpenAI 官方 / Claude via gateway。\n- 关键特性：当 `LLM_API_KEY` 为空（开发环境常见）时，`LLMClient` 会切到\n  `_disabled=True`，所有调用返回 `LLMDisabled` 异常，由上层走启发式降级。\n\n推荐用法：\n    llm = LLMClient.from_settings(get_settings())\n    if llm.enabled:\n        payload = await llm.chat_json(messages, schema_hint=\"ParsedIntent\")\n    else:\n        payload = heuristic_fallback(...)\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport logging\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom typing import Any\n\nimport httpx\n\nfrom app.core.config import Settings\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\n_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 20.0\n\n\nclass LLMDisabled(RuntimeError):\n    \"\"\"未配置 LLM_API_KEY，或调用被显式禁用。\"\"\"\n\n\nclass LLMError(RuntimeError):\n    \"\"\"LLM 返回非 2xx 或解析失败。\"\"\"\n\n\n@dataclass(slots=True)\nclass ChatMessage:\n    role: str\n    content: str\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, str]:\n        return {\"role\": self.role, \"content\": self.content}\n\n\nclass LLMClient:\n    \"\"\"极简 OpenAI 兼容客户端。\n\n    - `chat(messages)` 返回裸文本；\n    - `chat_json(messages)` 要求模型输出 JSON；解析失败会抛 `LLMError`，\n      上层可捕获后走启发式降级；\n    - 构造时可注入 `httpx.AsyncClient` 用于测试 mock。\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        *,\n        api_key: str,\n        base_url: str,\n        model: str,\n        timeout: float = _DEFAULT_TIMEOUT,\n        client: httpx.AsyncClient | None = None,\n    ) -> None:\n        self._api_key = api_key\n        self._base_url = base_url.rstrip(\"/\")\n        self._model = model\n        self._disabled = not api_key\n        self._client = client or httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=timeout)\n        self._owns_client = client is None\n\n    @classmethod\n    def from_settings(cls, settings: Settings) -> LLMClient:\n        return cls(\n            api_key=settings.llm_api_key,\n            base_url=settings.llm_base_url,\n            model=settings.llm_model,\n        )\n\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # properties\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    @property\n    def enabled(self) -> bool:\n        return not self._disabled\n\n    @property\n    def model(self) -> str:\n        return self._model\n\n    async def aclose(self) -> None:\n        if self._owns_client:\n            await self._client.aclose()\n\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # public\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    async def chat(\n        self,\n        messages: list[ChatMessage] | list[dict[str, str]],\n        *,\n        temperature: float = 0.3,\n        max_tokens: int | None = None,\n        response_format: dict[str, Any] | None = None,\n    ) -> str:\n        if self._disabled:\n            raise LLMDisabled(\"LLM_API_KEY 未配置，当前客户端已禁用\")\n\n        body: dict[str, Any] = {\n            \"model\": self._model,\n            \"messages\": [m.to_dict() if isinstance(m, ChatMessage) else m for m in messages],\n            \"temperature\": temperature,\n        }\n        if max_tokens is not None:\n            body[\"max_tokens\"] = max_tokens\n        if response_format is not None:\n            body[\"response_format\"] = response_format\n\n        try:\n            resp = await self._client.post(\n                f\"{self._base_url}/chat/completions\",\n                headers={\n                    \"Authorization\": f\"Bearer {self._api_key}\",\n                    \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\",\n                },\n                json=body,\n            )\n        except httpx.HTTPError as exc:\n            raise LLMError(f\"LLM 网络错误：{exc}\") from exc\n\n        if resp.status_code >= 400:\n            raise LLMError(f\"LLM 返回 {resp.status_code}: {resp.text[:400]}\")\n\n        try:\n            data = resp.json()\n            content = data[\"choices\"][0][\"message\"][\"content\"]\n        except (KeyError, IndexError, ValueError) as exc:\n            raise LLMError(f\"LLM 响应解析失败：{exc}; body={resp.text[:400]}\") from exc\n\n        if not isinstance(content, str):\n            raise LLMError(\"LLM 响应 content 字段非字符串\")\n        return content\n\n    async def chat_json(\n        self,\n        messages: list[ChatMessage] | list[dict[str, str]],\n        *,\n        temperature: float = 0.2,\n        max_tokens: int | None = None,\n    ) -> dict[str, Any] | list[Any]:\n        \"\"\"要求模型返回 JSON，宽松解析：先直接解析，失败再从 ``​`json``​` 包裹里拆。\"\"\"\n        raw = await self.chat(\n            messages,\n            temperature=temperature,\n            max_tokens=max_tokens,\n            response_format={\"type\": \"json_object\"},\n        )\n        return _safe_parse_json(raw)\n\n\ndef _safe_parse_json(raw: str) -> dict[str, Any] | list[Any]:\n    \"\"\"容错 JSON 解析：允许返回被 ``​`json ... ``​` 包裹。\"\"\"\n    text = raw.strip()\n    if not text:\n        raise LLMError(\"LLM 返回空字符串\")\n\n    try:\n        return json.loads(text)\n    except json.JSONDecodeError:\n        pass\n\n    stripped = text\n    if stripped.startswith(\"``​`\"):\n        # 去掉围栏\n        stripped = stripped.strip(\"`\")\n        if stripped.startswith(\"json\"):\n            stripped = stripped[len(\"json\") :]\n        stripped = stripped.strip()\n\n    # 找第一个 { ... } 或 [ ... ]\n    for opener, closer in ((\"{\", \"}\"), (\"[\", \"]\")):\n        start = stripped.find(opener)\n        end = stripped.rfind(closer)\n        if start != -1 and end != -1 and end > start:\n            candidate = stripped[start : end + 1]\n            try:\n                return json.loads(candidate)\n            except json.JSONDecodeError:\n                continue\n\n    raise LLMError(f\"无法从 LLM 响应中解析出 JSON: {text[:200]}\")\n\n\n__all__ = [\n    \"ChatMessage\",\n    \"LLMClient\",\n    \"LLMDisabled\",\n    \"LLMError\",\n]\n"
}

graph.astream(initial_state, stream_mode=\"updates\"):\n        ...\n\n`stream_mode=\"updates\"` 会在每个节点执行完毕后把该节点的 partial update 推出来，\n用这个就能实现\"节点级增量 SSE\"。\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Any, Callable, Coroutine\n\nfrom langgraph.graph import END, START, StateGraph\n\nfrom app.agents.nodes import (\n    AgentDeps,\n    cluster_anchor,\n    holiday_enrich,\n    hotel_fanout,\n    itinerary_compose,\n    parse_intent,\n    poi_expand,\n    rank_and_explain,\n)\nfrom app.agents.state import AgentState\n\nNodeFn = Callable[[AgentState], Coroutine[Any, Any, AgentState]]\n\n#: 节点顺序，前端进度条按照它渲染 7 个步骤\nNODE_ORDER: list[str] = [\n    \"parse_intent\",\n    \"holiday_enrich\",\n    \"poi_expand\",\n    \"cluster_anchor\",\n    \"hotel_fanout\",\n    \"rank_and_explain\",\n    \"itinerary_compose\",\n]\n\n\ndef _bind(fn, deps: AgentDeps) -> NodeFn:\n    async def wrapper(state: AgentState) -> AgentState:\n        return await fn(state, deps=deps)\n\n    wrapper.__name__ = fn.__name__\n    return wrapper\n\n\ndef build_plan_graph(deps: AgentDeps):\n    \"\"\"编排 7 节点图，返回已编译的 LangGraph runnable。\"\"\"\n    builder: StateGraph[AgentState] = StateGraph(AgentState)\n\n    builder.add_node(\"parse_intent\", _bind(parse_intent, deps))\n    builder.add_node(\"holiday_enrich\", _bind(holiday_enrich, deps))\n    builder.add_node(\"poi_expand\", _bind(poi_expand, deps))\n    builder.add_node(\"cluster_anchor\", _bind(cluster_anchor, deps))\n    builder.add_node(\"hotel_fanout\", _bind(hotel_fanout, deps))\n    builder.add_node(\"rank_and_explain\", _bind(rank_and_explain, deps))\n    builder.add_node(\"itinerary_compose\", _bind(itinerary_compose, deps))\n\n    builder.add_edge(START, \"parse_intent\")\n    builder.add_edge(\"parse_intent\", \"holiday_enrich\")\n    builder.add_edge(\"holiday_enrich\", \"poi_expand\")\n    builder.add_edge(\"poi_expand\", \"cluster_anchor\")\n    builder.add_edge(\"cluster_anchor\", \"hotel_fanout\")\n    builder.add_edge(\"hotel_fanout\", \"rank_and_explain\")\n    builder.add_edge(\"rank_and_explain\", \"itinerary_compose\")\n  "contents": "\"\"\"/api/trips —— 行程规划入口。\n\n- `POST /draft`：保留的轻量 stub，便于前端做最小链路冒烟。\n- `POST /plan`：M4 里程碑——通过 LangGraph 7 节点编排 AI 规划，以 SSE 把\n  每个节点的中间结果和最终 `PlanResult` 增量推给前端。\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport asyncio\nimport json\nimport logging\nfrom collections.abc import AsyncIterator\nfrom datetime import date\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends\nfrom fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse\nfrom pydantic import BaseModel, Field\n\nfrom app.agents import PlanEvent, PlanRequest, stream_plan\nfrom app.api.deps import get_hotel_registry, get_maps_client\nfrom app.providers.hotels import ProviderRegistry\nfrom app.providers.maps import MapsClient\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/trips\", tags=[\"trips\"])\n\n\nclass TripRequest(BaseModel):\n    city: str\n    check_in: date\n    check_out: date\n    must_visit: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description=\"必去 POI 关键词\")\n    budget_per_night: float | None = None\n    preferences: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)\n\n\nclass TripDraft(BaseModel):\n    message: str\n    status: str = \"draft\"\n\n\n@router.post(\"/draft\", response_model=TripDraft)\nasync def draft_trip(payload: TripRequest) -> TripDraft:\n    return TripDraft(\n        message=(\n            f\"收到 {payload.city} {payload.check_in}~{payload.check_out} 的规划请求（stub），\"\n            \"需要完整 AI 流程请改用 POST /api/trips/plan。\"\n        ),\n    )\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# SSE plan endpoint\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef _get_maps_or_none() -> MapsClient | None:\n    \"\"\"地图依赖允许缺失：没有 AMAP_KEY 时 agent 自己走启发式。\"\"\"\n    try:\n        return get_maps_client()\n    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001\n        logger.warning(\"MapsClient 未就绪，agent 将降级：%s\", exc)\n        return None\n\n\n@router.post(\"/plan\")\nasync def plan_trip(\n    payload: PlanRequest,\n    registry: ProviderRegistry = Depends(get_hotel_registry),\n) -> StreamingResponse:\n    \"\"\"执行 LangGraph 7 节点规划，用 SSE 增量回推。\n\n    前端消费约定：\n    - `event: node_start` / `event: node_end` 字段在 data 里，data 是 `PlanEvent.model_dump()`；\n    - 最后一帧是 `event: done`，data.result 是完整的 `PlanResult`；\n    - 失败是 `event: error`。\n    \"\"\"\n    maps_client = _get_maps_or_none()\n    event_stream = stream_plan(payload, hotels=registry, maps=maps_client)\n\n    async def sse() -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:\n        # 先发一个 retry 指令，避免连接掉线后浏览器无意义重连\n        yield b\"retry: 10000\\n\\n\"\n        try:\n            async for ev in event_stream:\n                yield _encode_sse(ev)\n                # 让出控制权，避免某一节点很快时客户端没机会消费\n                await asyncio.sleep(0)\n        except asyncio.CancelledError:\n            logger.info(\"SSE 客户端提前断开\")\n            raise\n        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001\n            logger.exception(\"SSE 规划失败\")\n            err = PlanEvent(kind=\"error\", message=f\"服务端异常：{exc}\")\n            yield _encode_sse(err)\n\n    return StreamingResponse(\n        sse(),\n        media_type=\"text/event-stream\",\n        headers={\n            \"Cache-Control\": \"no-cache, no-transform\",\n            \"Connection\": \"keep-alive\",\n            \"X-Accel-Buffering\": \"no\",  # 让 nginx 不要缓冲\n        },\n    )\n\n\ndef _encode_sse(event: PlanEvent) -> bytes:\n    \"\"\"把 PlanEvent 编码成浏览器 EventSource 可解析的 SSE 帧。\n\n    - `event:` 字段用 `kind`，方便前端用 `addEventListener('node_end', ...)`；\n    - `data:` 是整帧 JSON，前端按需解析 `phase` / `data` / `shape`。\n    \"\"\"\n    payload = event.model_dump(mode=\"json\")\n    body = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False)\n    return f\"event: {event.kind}\\ndata: {body}\\n\\n\".encode(\"utf-8\")\n"
}

phases: INITIAL_PHASES,\n    events: [],\n    snapshots: {},\n    result: null,\n  })\n  const controllerRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null)\n\n  const reset = useCallback(() => {\n    controllerRef.current?.abort()\n    controllerRef.current = null\n    setState({\n      running: false,\n      error: null,\n      phases: INITIAL_PHASES,\n      events: [],\n      snapshots: {},\n      result: null,\n    })\n  }, [])\n\n  const run = useCallback(\n    async (payload: PlanRequestPayload): Promise<PlanResult | null> => {\n      controllerRef.current?.abort()\n      const ctrl = new AbortController()\n      controllerRef.current = ctrl\n\n      setState({\n        running: true,\n        error: null,\n        phases: INITIAL_PHASES,\n        events: [],\n        snapshots: {},\n        result: null,\n      })\n\n      const handleEvent = (ev: PlanEvent) => {\n        setState((prev) => {\n          const next = { ...prev, events: [...prev.events, ev] }\n\n          if (ev.phase && (ev.kind === 'node_start' || ev.kind === 'node_end' || ev.kind === 'node_error')) {\n            next.phases = prev.phases.map((p) => {\n              if (p.phase !== ev.phase) return p\n              if (ev.kind === 'node_start') {\n                return { ...p, status: 'running', message: ev.message }\n              }\n              if (ev.kind === 'node_end') {\n                return {\n                  ...p,\n                  status: 'done',\n                  message: ev.message,\n                  data: ev.data,\n                }\n              }\n              return { ...p, status: 'error', message: ev.message }\n            })\n          }\n\n          if (ev.kind === 'node_end' && ev.phase && ev.data) {\n            next.snapshots = { ...prev.snapshots, [ev.phase]: ev.data }\n          }\n          if (ev.kind === 'error') {\n            next.error = ev.message\n          }\n          return next\n        })\n      }\n\n      try {\n        const result = await streamPlan(payload, {\n          onEvent: handleEvent,\n          signal: ctrl.signal,\n        })\n        if (ctrl.signal.aborted) return null\n        setState((prev) => ({\n          ...prev,\n          running: false,\n          result,\n          error: null,\n        }))\n        return result\n      } catch (err) {\n        if (ctrl.signal.aborted) return null\n        const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)\n        setState((prev) => ({\n          ...prev,\n          running: false,\n          error: msg,\n          phases: prev.phases.map((p) =>\n            p.status === 'running' ? { ...p, status: 'error' as PhaseStatus, message: msg } : p,\n          ),\n        }))\n        return null\n      }\n    },\n    [],\n  )\n\n  const cancel = useCallback(() => {\n    controllerRef.current?.abort()\n    controllerRef.current = null\n    setState((prev) => ({ ...prev, running: false }))\n  }, [])\n\n  return { state, run, cancel, reset }\n}\n"

## 后端（LangGraph 7 节点规划图）

**新模块 `backend/app/agents/`**
- `schemas.py` — `PlanRequest` / `PlanEvent` / `PlanResult` 等对外 Pydantic DTO
- `state.py` — LangGraph 内部 TypedDict `AgentState`，`notes` 字段走 reducer 合并
- `prompts.py` — 4 个 prompt 模板（intent / anchor / rank / itinerary）
- `nodes.py` — 7 个节点函数 + `AgentDeps` 容器，每个节点都带启发式降级
- `graph.py` — 用 `StateGraph` 线性串起 7 节点，`build_plan_graph(deps)` 返回 compiled runnable
- `runner.py` — `stream_plan(...)` 异步生成器，把 LangGraph `astream(updates)` 翻译成 `PlanEvent`

**API 端点**：`backend/app/api/trips.py` 新增 `POST /api/trips/plan`，`StreamingResponse(text/event-stream)` 以 `event: node_start/node_end/done/error` 帧格式推送。

 "contents": "\"\"\"联网搜索兜底：rednote-mcp 不可用时退化为通用 Web 搜索。\n\n策略：\n- 默认使用 DuckDuckGo HTML 端点（免注册，HTML 渲染），解析前 N 条结果；\n- 命中结果会被标 `source='websearch'`，上层 UI 要提示\"来自搜索引擎\"而非笔记原文；\n- 在用户配置 `TAVILY_API_KEY` / `BING_SEARCH_KEY` 时，可在 factory 层切换。\n\n该模块只依赖 `httpx` + 轻量 HTML 正则，无需额外安装 bs4/selectolax。\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport html as html_mod\nimport logging\nimport re\nfrom typing import Any\n\nimport httpx\n\nfrom app.providers.social.base import SocialNote\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\n\n_DDG_URL = \"https://html.duckduckgo.com/html/\"\n_RESULT_BLOCK = re.compile(\n    r'<a[^>]+class=\"result__a\"[^>]*href=\"([^\"]+)\"[^>]*>(?P<title>.*?)</a>'\n    r'.*?<a[^>]*class=\"result__snippet\"[^>]*>(?P<snippet>.*?)</a>',\n    re.DOTALL,\n)\n_TAG_RE = re.compile(r\"<[^>]+>\")\n\n\nclass WebSearchClient:\n    \"\"\"通用搜索引擎 client，满足 SocialClient 协议。\"\"\"\n\n    name: str = \"websearch\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        *,\n        http_client: httpx.AsyncClient | None = None,\n        query_suffix: str = \"小红书 OR 点评 OR 体验\",\n        timeout: float = 8.0,\n    ) -> None:\n        self._client = http_client or httpx.AsyncClient(\n            timeout=timeout,\n            headers={\n                \"User-Agent\": (\n                    \"Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; HolidayHotelPlanner/0.1; \"\n                    \"+https://example.com/bot)\"\n                )\n            },\n        )\n        self._owns_client = http_client is None\n        self._query_suffix = query_suffix\n\n    async def aclose(self) -> None:\n        if self._owns_client:\n            await self._client.aclose()\n\n    async def search_notes(\n        self, keyword: str, *, limit: int = 10\n    ) -> list[SocialNote]:\n        query = f\"{keyword} {self._query_suffix}\".strip()\n        try:\n            resp = await self._client.post(\n                _DDG_URL, data={\"q\": query}\n            )\n        except httpx.HTTPError as exc:\n            logger.warning(\"web 搜索失败：%s\", exc)\n            return []\n        if resp.status_code >= 400:\n            logger.warning(\"web 搜索 status=%s\", resp.status_code)\n            return []\n        return _parse_ddg_html(resp.text, limit=limit)\n\n    async def note_detail(self, note_id: str) -> SocialNote | None:\n        # Web 搜索不提供 detail，保留协议兼容\n        return None\n\n\ndef _parse_ddg_html(text: str, *, limit: int) -> list[SocialNote]:\n    notes: list[SocialNote] = []\n    for idx, match in enumerate(_RESULT_BLOCK.finditer(text)):\n        if len(notes) >= limit:\n            break\n        url = _clean_ddg_url(match.group(1))\n        title = _strip_html(match.group(\"title\")).strip()\n        snippet = _strip_html(match.group(\"snippet\")).strip()\n        if not (title or snippet):\n            continue\n        notes.append(\n            SocialNote(\n                source=\"websearch\",\n                note_id=f\"web-{idx}-{hash(url) & 0xFFFFFFFF:x}\",\n                title=title or None,\n                content=snippet or title,\n                author=None,\n                url=url or None,\n                thumbnail=None,\n                posted_at=None,\n                likes=None,\n                comments=None,\n            )\n        )\n    return notes\n\n\ndef _clean_ddg_url(raw: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"DDG 返回的 href 常是 /l/?uddg=... 形式，尽力抽出真实 URL。\"\"\"\n    if not raw:\n        return \"\"\n    raw = html_mod.unescape(raw).strip()\n    if raw.startswith(\"/l/?\") or raw.startswith(\"//duckduckgo.com/l/?\"):\n        marker = \"uddg=\"\n        i = raw.find(marker)\n        if i >= 0:\n            rest = raw[i + len(marker) :]\n            rest = rest.split(\"&\", 1)[0]\n            from urllib.parse import unquote\n\n            return unquote(rest)\n    if raw.startswith(\"//\"):\n        return f\"https:{raw}\"\n    return raw\n\n\ndef _strip_html(raw: str) -> str:\n    return html_mod.unescape(_TAG_RE.sub(\"\", raw or \"\"))\n\n\ndef _as_str_list(payload: Any) -> list[str]:\n    if isinstance(payload, list):\n        return [str(x) for x in payload if x]\n    return []\n"
}

   except MCPUnavailable as exc:\n            logger.warning(\"rednote detail 不可用，回退：%s\", exc)\n            self._primary_disabled = True\n            return await self._fallback.note_detail(note_id)\n\n\ndef build_default_social_client(\n    settings: Settings | None = None,\n) -> SocialClient:\n    settings = settings or get_settings()\n    transport = (os.environ.get(\"SOCIAL_TRANSPORT\") or \"auto\").lower()\n    if transport not in (\"auto\", \"rednote\", \"websearch\", \"none\"):\n        logger.warning(\"SOCIAL_TRANSPORT=%s 未识别，回退到 auto\", transport)\n        transport = \"auto\"\n\n    if transport == \"none\":\n        return NullSocialClient()\n\n    if transport == \"websearch\":\n        return WebSearchClient()\n\n    web = rednote\n    return CompositeSocialClient(primary=rednote, fallback=web)\n"

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\Hotel Manger\\backend\\app\\services\\llm.py",
 "contents": "\"\"\"极简 OpenAI-兼容 LLM 客户端（基于 httpx）。\n\n选型理由：\n- 生产默认走 Kimi / Moonshot，请求协议与 OpenAI Chat Completions 兼容；\n- 只暴露一个 `chat_json(messages, schema_hint)` 方法，让上层专注业务；\n- 不引入 `openai` SDK，减少依赖 & 方便在没有 key 的环境下静默降级。\n\n未配置 `LLM_API_KEY` 时 `is_available=False`，上层会切到规则兜底，保证\nAPI 在离线/CI 环境依然可用。\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport logging\nfrom typing import Any\n\nimport httpx\n\nfrom app.core.config import Settings, get_settings\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\n\nclass LLMError(RuntimeError):\n    \"\"\"LLM 请求失败（网络、鉴权、非法 JSON 返回等）。\"\"\"\n\n\nclass LLMClient:\n    \"\"\"OpenAI-兼容 Chat Completions 客户端。\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        *,\n        api_key: str,\n        base_url: str,\n        model: str,\n        timeout: float = 30.0,\n        http_client: httpx.AsyncClient | None = None,\n    ) -> None:\n        self._api_key = api_key\n        self._base_url = base_url.rstrip(\"/\")\n        self._model = model\n        self._client = http_client or httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=timeout)\n        self._owns_client = http_client is None\n\n    @classmethod\n    def from_settings(cls, settings: Settings | None = None) -> \"LLMClient\":\n        settings = settings or get_settings()\n        return cls(\n            api_key=settings.llm_api_key,\n            base_url=settings.llm_base_url,\n            model=settings.llm_model,\n        )\n\n    async def aclose(self) -> None:\n        if self._owns_client:\n            await self._client.aclose()\n\n    @property\n    def is_available(self) -> bool:\n        return bool(self._api_key) and bool(self._base_url) and bool(self._model)\n\n    async def chat_json(\n        self,\n        *,\n        system: str,\n        user: str,\n        temperature: float = 0.2,\n        max_tokens: int = 512,\n    ) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        \"\"\"调用 chat completions，期望模型返回合法 JSON 对象。\n\n        使用 `response_format=json_object`（OpenAI/Kimi/DeepSeek 都支持），同时\n        在 prompt 里强约束模型只输出 JSON。失败时抛 `LLMError`，由调用方决定降级。\n        \"\"\"\n        if not self.is_available:\n            raise LLMError(\"LLM_API_KEY 未配置，无法调用\")\n\n        url = f\"{self._base_url}/chat/completions\"\n        payload = {\n            \"model\": self._model,\n            \"temperature\": temperature,\n            \"max_tokens\": max_tokens,\n            \"response_format\": {\"type\": \"json_object\"},\n            \"messages\": [\n                {\"role\": \"system\", \"content\": system},\n                {\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": user},\n            ],\n        }\n        try:\n            resp = await self._client.post(\n                url,\n                json=payload,\n                headers={\n                    \"Authorization\": f\"Bearer {self._api_key}\",\n                    \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\",\n                },\n            )\n        except httpx.HTTPError as exc:\n            raise LLMError(f\"LLM 请求失败: {exc}\") from exc\n\n        if resp.status_code >= 400:\n            raise LLMError(\n                f\"LLM 返回 {resp.status_code}: {resp.text[:300]}\"\n            )\n\n        try:\n            body = resp.json()\n            content = body[\"choices\"][0][\"message\"][\"content\"]\n        except (ValueError, KeyError, IndexError) as exc:\n            raise LLMError(f\"LLM 响应结构异常: {exc}\") from exc\n\n        return _parse_json_content(content)\n\n\ndef _parse_json_content(raw: str) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"尝试解析 LLM 输出为 JSON，兼容 markdown 代码块包裹。\"\"\"\n    text = raw.strip()\n    if text.startswith(\"``​`\"):\n        # ``​`json\\n...\\n``​` 或 ``​`\\n...\\n``​`\n        text = text.strip(\"`\")\n        if text.lower().startswith(\"json\"):\n            text = text[4:]\n        text = text.strip()\n        if text.endswith(\"``​`\"):\n            text = text[:-3].strip()\n    try:\n        data = json.loads(text)\n    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:\n        raise LLMError(f\"LLM 返回非 JSON: {raw[:200]}\") from exc\n    if not isinstance(data, dict):\n        raise LLMError(\"LLM 返回非对象 JSON\")\n    return data\n"
}
