total_chars = 0\n\n        for note in notes:\n            text = f\"{note.title or ''} {note.content}\"\n            total_chars += len(text)\n            for kw, phrase in _POSITIVE_KEYWORDS:\n                if kw in text and phrase not in highlights:\n                    highlights.append(phrase)\n            for kw, phrase in _NEGATIVE_KEYWORDS:\n                if kw in text and phrase not in complaints:\n                    complaints.append(phrase)\n            pos_hits += sum(1 for w in _POSITIVE_SCORE_WORDS if w in text)\n            neg_hits += sum(1 for w in _NEGATIVE_SCORE_WORDS if w in text)\n            for tag in _pick_tags(text):\n                if tag not in tags:\n                    tags.append(tag)\n\n        highlights = highlights[:5]\n        complaints = complaints[:5]\n        tags = tags[:6]\n\n        total_hits = pos_hits + neg_hits\n        if total_hits == 0:\n            sentiment = 0.0\n        else:\n            sentiment = round((pos_hits - neg_hits) / total_hits, 2)\n        sentiment = max(-1.0, min(1.0, sentiment))\n\n        summary = _build_summary(highlights, complaints, sentiment)\n        return SocialInsights(\n            highlights=highlights,\n            complaints=complaints,\n            tags=tags,\n            sentiment=sentiment,\n            summary=summary,\n        )\n\n\n_TAG_CANDIDATES = (\n    (\"亲子\", \"亲子友好\"),\n    (\"情侣\", \"情侣度假\"),\n    (\"商务\", \"商务出行\"),\n    (\"网红\", \"网红打卡\"),\n    (\"打卡\", \"网红打卡\"),\n    (\"温泉\", \"温泉度假\"),\n    (\"海景\", \"海景景观\"),\n    (\"地铁\", \"交通便利\"),\n    (\"机场\", \"机场便利\"),\n    (\"早餐\", \"含早推荐\"),\n    (\"性价比\", \"性价比高\"),\n    (\"安静\", \"环境安静\"),\n)\n\n\ndef _pick_tags(text: str) -> list[str]:\n    return [tag for kw, tag in _TAG_CANDIDATES if kw in text]\n\n\ndef _build_summary(\n    highlights: list[str], complaints: list[str], sentiment: float\n) -> str | None:\n    if not highlights and not complaints:\n        return None\n    if sentiment >= 0.3 and highlights:\n        return \"整体口碑不错：\" + \"、\".join(highlights[:2])\n    if sentiment <= -0.3 and complaints:\n        return \"需注意：\" + \"、\".join(complaints[:2])\n    parts: list[str] = []\n    if highlights:\n        parts.append(\"好评：\" + \"、\".join(highlights[:2]))\n    if complaints:\n        parts.append(\"吐槽：\" + \"、\".join(complaints[:2]))\n    return \" / \".join(parts) or None\n\n\ndef _count_sources(notes: list[SocialNote]) -> dict[str, int]:\n    out: dict[str, int] = {}\n    for n in notes:\n        out[n.source] = out.get(n.source, 0) + 1\n    return out\n\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# LLM 返回 payload 的校验\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef _build_insights_from_payload(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> SocialInsights:\n    highlights = _clean_list(payload.get(\"highlights\"), limit=5, item_max=30)\n    complaints = _clean_list(payload.get(\"complaints\"), limit=5, item_max=30)\n    tags = _clean_list(payload.get(\"tags\"), limit=6, item_max=12)\n    sentiment_raw = payload.get(\"sentiment\")\n    try:\n        sentiment = float(sentiment_raw) if sentiment_raw is not None else 0.0\n    except (TypeError, ValueError):\n        sentiment = 0.0\n    sentiment = max(-1.0, min(1.0, sentiment))\n\n    summary_raw = payload.get(\"summary\")\n    summary: str | None = None\n    if isinstance(summary_raw, str) and summary_raw.strip():\n        summary = summary_raw.strip()\n        if len(summary) > 80:\n            summary = summary[:80] + \"…\"\n\n    return SocialInsights(\n        highlights=highlights,\n        complaints=complaints,\n        tags=tags,\n        sentiment=round(sentiment, 2),\n        summary=summary,\n    )\n\n\ndef _clean_list(value: Any, *, limit: int, item_max: int) -> list[str]:\n    if not isinstance(value, list):\n        return []\n    out: list[str] = []\n    for item in value:\n        if item is None:\n            continue\n        text = str(item).strip()\n        text = re.sub(r\"\\s+\", \" \", text)\n        if not text:\n            continue\n        if len(text) > item_max:\n            text = text[: item_max - 1] + \"…\"\n        if text not in out:\n            out.append(text)\n        if len(out) >= limit:\n            break\n    return out\n"
}

- 节假日溢价惩罚 (holiday premium penalty)

 "contents": "\"\"\"酒店综合打分与重排序。\n\n用 5 个维度算加权分，每一项都归一到 [0, 1]（越高越好），按配置权重聚合得到\n0~100 的 `score`，并保留每一维的打分与解释，方便前端 UI 呈现「为什么排第一」。\n\n维度：\n1. `price`：相对候选集分位数的价格优势；\n2. `commute`：距锚点距离/通勤时长；\n3. `rating`：官方评分（0-10 归一到 0-1）；\n4. `social`：社媒情感分（-1~1 → 0~1）；\n5. `holiday_penalty`：节假日溢价惩罚（由价格相对平日基线衡量）。\n\n设计原则：\n- 纯函数 + dataclass，无状态，便于单测；\n- 各维度可选（None 时按中位数 0.5 兜底），避免少数据场景把某候选压死；\n- 排序稳定：相同分数按 (距离, 价格) 次序回退，和 MVP 行为兼容。\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom pydantic import BaseModel, Field\n\nfrom app.schemas import HotelOffer\n\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 配置\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass RankingWeights:\n    \"\"\"5 个维度的权重，未归一的原始系数，打分时自动归一。\"\"\"\n\n    price: float = 0.30\n    commute: float = 0.25\n    rating: float = 0.20\n    social: float = 0.15\n    holiday_penalty: float = 0.10\n\n    def normalized(self) -> \"RankingWeights\":\n        total = self.price + self.commute + self.rating + self.social + self.holiday_penalty\n        if total <= 0:\n            raise ValueError(\"RankingWeights 所有权重和必须 > 0\")\n        scale = 1.0 / total\n        return RankingWeights(\n            price=self.price * scale,\n            commute=self.commute * scale,\n            rating=self.rating * scale,\n            social=self.social * scale,\n            holiday_penalty=self.holiday_penalty * scale,\n        )\n\n\nDEFAULT_WEIGHTS = RankingWeights()\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass RankingContext:\n    \"\"\"外部注入的打分上下文。\"\"\"\n\n    commute_minutes: dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    \"\"\"global_id/hotel_id → 通勤分钟数（距 POI 锚点）。\"\"\"\n\n    sentiment: dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    \"\"\"global_id/hotel_id → 社媒情感分 ∈ [-1, 1]。\"\"\"\n\n    expected_price_multiplier: float = 1.0\n    \"\"\"来自 `peak_warning` 的节假日预期涨幅，1.0 表示平日。\"\"\"\n\n    baseline_price_cny: float | None = None\n    \"\"\"该酒店在平日的参考价（CNY），用于衡量溢价。None 时用候选集中位数兜底。\"\"\"\n\n    def lookup_commute(self, offer: HotelOffer) -> float | None:\n        return self.commute_minutes.get(offer.global_id or offer.hotel_id)\n\n    def lookup_sentiment(self, offer: HotelOffer) -> float | None:\n        return self.sentiment.get(offer.global_id or offer.hotel_id)\n\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 打分结果 DTO\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\nclass RankingBreakdown(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"每个维度归一后的 0-1 子分（便于前端展示进度条）。\"\"\"\n\n    price: float = Field(0.0, ge=0.0, le=1.0)\n    commute: float = Field(0.0, ge=0.0, le=1.0)\n    rating: float = Field(0.0, ge=0.0, le=1.0)\n    social: float = Field(0.0, ge=0.0, le=1.0)\n    holiday_penalty: float = Field(0.0, ge=0.0, le=1.0)\n\n\nclass RankedHotel(BaseModel):\n    \"\"\"对外暴露的打分结果。\"\"\"\n\n    offer: HotelOffer\n    score: float = Field(..., ge=0.0, le=100.0)\n    breakdown: RankingBreakdown\n    reasons: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description=\"人类可读的加分/扣分说明\")\n\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 打分主流程\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef rank_offers(\n    offers: list[HotelOffer],\n    *,\n    context: RankingContext | None = None,\n    weights: RankingWeights | None = None,\n) -> list[RankedHotel]:\n    \"\"\"按综合分降序返回打分结果。原 offers 顺序不变，结果 offer 为同一引用的 copy。\"\"\"\n    if not offers:\n        return []\n    ctx = context or RankingContext()\n    w = (weights or DEFAULT_WEIGHTS).normalized()\n\n    prices = [o.price_per_night for o in offers if o.price_per_night > 0]\n    if prices:\n        price_lo = min(prices)\n        price_hi = max(prices)\n        price_median = sorted(prices)[len(prices) // 2]\n    else:\n        price_lo = price_hi = price_median = 1.0\n\n    commutes = [\n        v for v in (ctx.lookup_commute(o) for o max(commutes)\n    elif distance_kms:\n        commute_lo = min(distance_kms)\n        commute_hi = max(distance_kms)\n    else:\n        commute_lo = commute_hi = 0.0\n\n    baseline = ctx.baseline_price_cny or price_median\n    expected_mult = max(1.0, ctx.expected_price_multiplier)\n\n    ranked: list[RankedHotel] = []\n    for offer in offers:\n        price_score = _score_price(offer.price_per_night, price_lo, price_hi)\n        commute_val, commute_score = _score_commute(\n            offer, ctx, lo=commute_lo, hi=commute_hi\n        )\n        rating_score = w.commute\n            + rating_score * w.rating\n            + social_score * w.social\n            + penalty_score * w.holiday_penalty\n        )\n        score = round(total * 100, 2)\n\n        reasons = _explain(\n            offer=offer,\n            breakdown=breakdown,\n            price_lo=price_lo,\n            commute_val=commute_val,\n            social_val=social_val,\n            overpaid_pct=overpaid_pct,\n            holiday_active=expected_mult > 1.05,\n        )\n\n        ranked.append(\n            RankedHotel(offer=offer, score=score, breakdown=breakdown, reasons=reasons)\n        )\n\n    ranked.sort(\n        key=lambda r: (\n            -r.score,\n            r.offer.distance_km if r.offer.distance_km is not None else float(\"inf\"),\n            r.offer.price_per_night,\n        )\n    )\n    return ranked\n\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 单维打分\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef _score_price(price: float, lo: float, hi: float) -> float:\n    if price <= 0 or hi <= lo:\n        return 0.5\n    # 线性：最便宜 → 1.0，最贵 → 0.0\n    return max(0.0, min(1.0, 1.0 - (price - lo) / (hi - lo)))\n\n\ndef _score_commute(\n    offer: HotelOffer,\n    ctx: RankingContext,\n    *,\n    lo: float,\n    hi: float,\n) -> tuple[float | None, float]:\n    commute = ctx.lookup_commute(offer)\n    if commute is None:\n        # 回退到距离（km）\n        if offer.distance_km is None:\n            return None, 0.5\n        commute = offer.distance_km\n    if hi <= lo:\n        return commute, 1.0\n    score = max(0.0, min(1.0, 1.0 - (commute - lo) / (hi - lo)))\n    return commute, score\n\n\ndef _score_rating(review_score: float | None) -> float:\n    if review_score is None:\n        return 0.5\n    return max(0.0, min(1.0, review_score / 10.0))\n\n\ndef _score_social(\n    offer: HotelOffer, ctx: RankingContext\n) -> tuple[float | None, float]:\n    sentiment = ctx.lookup_sentiment(offer)\n    if sentiment is None:\n        return None, 0.5\n    sentiment = max(-1.0, min(1.0, sentiment))\n    return sentiment, (sentiment + 1.0) / 2.0\n\n\ndef _score_holiday_penalty(\n    price: float, *, baseline: float, expected_mult: float\n) -> tuple[float, float]:\n    \"\"\"衡量「相比平日溢价多少」。\n\n    - 节假日 expected_mult > 1 时，基线按 `baseline * expected_mult` 放大；\n    - 实际价格超过\"合理区间\"的部分会被线性扣分；\n    - 返回 (score 0-1, 超出百分比 0-∞)。\n    \"\"\"\n    if baseline <= 0:\n        return 0.5, 0.0\n    reasonable_ceiling = baseline * expected_mult\n    if price <= reasonable_ceiling:\n        return 1.0, 0.0\n    # 超过 50% 即扣到底\n    overpaid_pct = (price - reasonable_ceiling) / reasonable_ceiling\n    score = max(0.0, 1.0 - overpaid_pct * 2.0)\n    return score, overpaid_pct\n\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 解释文案\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef _explain(\n    *,\n    offer: HotelOffer,\n    breakdown: RankingBreakdown,\n    price_lo: float,\n    commute_val: float | None,\n    social_val: float | None,\n    overpaid_pct: float,\n    holiday_active: bool,\n) -> list[str]:\n    reasons: list[str] = []\n    if breakdown.price >= 0.75:\n        reasons.append(\n            f\"价格领先（¥{int(offer.price_per_night)} 接近候选最低 ¥{int(price_lo)}）\"\n        )\n    elif breakdown.price <= 0.25:\n        reasons.append(f\"价格偏高（¥{int(offer.price_per_night)}/晚）\")\n\n    if commute_val is not None:\n        if breakdown.commute >= 0.75:\n            reasons.append(f\"通勤优势：约 {int(commute_val)} 分钟/km 到锚点\")\n        elif breakdown.commute <= 0.25:\n            reasons.append(f\"通勤偏远：约 {int(commute_val)} 分钟/km\")\n\n    if offer.review_score is not None:\n        if breakdown.rating >= 0.8:\n            reasons.append(f\"官方评分 {offer.review_score:.1f}，口碑领先\")\n        elif breakdown.rating <= 0.5:\n            reasons.append(f\"官方评分 {offer.review_score:.1f}，低于候选均值\")\n\n    if social_val is not None:\n        if social_val >= 0.3:\n            reasons.append(f\"社媒情感正向（{social_val:+.2f}）\")\n        elif social_val <= -0.3:\n            reasons.append(f\"社媒情感偏负（{social_val:+.2f}）\")\n\n    if holiday_active:\n        if breakdown.holiday_penalty >= 0.9:\n            reasons.append(\"节假日但价格仍在合理区间，涨幅可控\")\n        elif overpaid_pct >= 0.2:\n            reasons.append(\n                f\"节假日溢价超合理区间 {int(overpaid_pct * 100)}%，谨慎选择\"\n            )\n\n    return reasons\n\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 便捷封装，用于在 API 层注入上下文\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef context_from_payload(payload: dict[str, Any] | None) -> RankingContext:\n    \"\"\"从 API query/body 的松散 payload 构建 RankingContext。\"\"\"\n    if not payload:\n        return RankingContext()\n    commute = _coerce_float_map(payload.get(\"commute_minutes\"))\n    sentiment = _coerce_float_map(payload.get(\"sentiment\"))\n    mult = payload.get(\"expected_price_multiplier\")\n    baseline = payload.get(\"baseline_price_cny\")\n    return RankingContext(\n        commute_minutes=commute,\n        sentiment=sentiment,\n        expected_price_multiplier=float(mult) if mult is not None else 1.0,\n        baseline_price_cny=float(baseline) if baseline is not None else None,\n    )\n\n\ndef _coerce_float_map(raw: Any) -> dict[str, float]:\n    if not isinstance(raw, dict):\n        return {}\n    out: dict[str, float] = {}\n    for k, v in raw.items():\n days // 2` 天前瞻；\n- 周末 +15%，法定节假日按 `chinese_calendar` 映射到对应涨幅；\n- 叠加 ±10% 的确定性抖动（`hash(seed+date)`），避免曲线过平。\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nfrom datetime import date, timedelta\n\nfrom pydantic import BaseModel, Field\n\nfrom app.services.holiday import classify_day\n\n\nclass PricePoint(BaseModel):\n    date: date\n    price: float = Field(..., description=\"采样价格（CNY）\")\n    is_weekend: bool = False\n    is_holiday: bool = False\n    holiday_name_cn: str | None = None\n\n\n_HOLIDAY_FACTORS: dict[str, float] = {\n    \"Spring Festival\": 2.2,\n    \"National Day\": 2.0,\n    \"Labour Day\": 1.65,\n    \"Mid-autumn Festival\": 1.55,\n    \"Dragon Boat Festival\": 1.45,\n    \"Tomb-sweeping Day\": 1.35,\n    \"New Year's Day\": 1.30,\n    \"Anti-Fascist 70th Day\": 1.30,\n}\n\n\ndef sample_price_history(\n    *,\n    seed: str,\n    current_price: float,\n    days: int = 30,\n    today: date | None = None,\n    expected_peak_multiplier: float = 1.0,\n) -> list[PricePoint]:\n    \"\"\"生成 `days` 天价格点（含今天），过去一半 + 未来一半。\n\n    Args:\n        seed: 稳定扰动来源，通常用 `provider:hotel_id`；\n        current_price: 当前每晚价格（人民币），作为基线；\n        days: 采样天数；\n        today: 可注入今日日期方便测试；\n        expected_peak_multiplier: 若该酒店对应的入住区间处于节假日，可传入 > 1 的\n            系数把未来几周的基线抬升（仅影响未来点，不影响历史点）。\n    \"\"\"\n    if days <= 0:\n        return []\n    if current_price <= 0:\n        current_price = 1.0\n    today = today or date.today()\n    backward = days // 2\n    forward = days - backward\n    points: list[PricePoint] = []\n    base_price = current_price\n\n    for offset in range(-backward, forward):\n        d = today + timedelta(days=offset)\n        info = classify_day(d)\n        factor = 1.0\n        if info.is_legal_holiday and info.holiday_name:\n            factor = _HOLIDAY_FACTORS.get(info.holiday_name, 1.5)\n        elif info.is_weekend and not info.is_makeup_workday:\n            factor = 1.15\n        if offset > 0 and expected_peak_multiplier > 1.0:\n            factor = max(factor, expected_peak_multiplier * 0.9)\n\n        jitter = _deterministic_jitter(seed, d)\n        price = base_price * factor * (1.0 + jitter)\n        price = round(max(50.0, price), 2)\n        points.append(\n            PricePoint(\n                date=d,\n                price=price,\n                is_weekend=info.is_weekend,\n                is_holiday=info.is_legal_holiday,\n                holiday_name_cn=info.holiday_name_cn,\n            )\n        )\n    return points\n\n\ndef _deterministic_jitter(seed: str, d: date) -> float:\n    \"\"\"把 (seed, date) 哈希成 [-0.10, +0.10] 的稳定抖动。\"\"\"\n    digest = hashlib.md5(f\"{seed}|{d.isoformat()}\".encode(\"utf-8\")).hexdigest()\n    value = int(digest[:8], 16) / 0xFFFFFFFF  # 0..1\n    return value * 0.2 - 0.1\n"

反向解码出原始文件名\n    utf8_part = disposition.split(\"filename*=UTF-8''\", 1)[1].strip(\" \\\"\")\n    decoded = unquote(utf8_part)\n    assert \"西安\" in decoded\n\n\ndef test_api_export_md_invalid_dates(client: TestClient) -> None:\n    resp = client.get(\n        \"/api/itineraries/export.md\",\n        params={\n            \"city\": \"北京\",\n            \"check_in\": \"2026-05-10\",\n            \"check_out\": \"2026-05-08\",\n        },\n    )\n    assert resp.status_code == 422\n\n\ndef test_api_export_pdf_returns_pdf_bytes(client: TestClient) -> None:\n    resp = client.get(\n        \"/api/itineraries/export.pdf\",\n        params={\n            \"city\": \"北京\",\n            \"check_in\": \"2026-05-10\",\n            \"check_out\": \"2026-05-12\",\n            \"must_visit\": [\"故宫\", \"什刹海\"],\n        },\n    )\n    if resp.status_code == 503:\n        pytest.skip(\"reportlab 未安装\")\n    assert resp.status_code == 200\n    assert resp.headers[\"content-type\"] == \"application/pdf\"\n    assert resp.content[:4] == b\"%PDF\"\n    assert \"attachment\" in resp.headers.get(\"content-disposition\", \"\")\n\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 价格曲线\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_price_history_basic_shape() -> None:\n    points = sample_price_history(\n        seed=\"mock:x-1\",\n        current_price=500,\n        days=14,\n        today=date(2026, 4, 21),\n    )\n    assert len(points) == 14\n    assert points[0].date < points[-1].date\n    assert all(p.price > 0 for p in points)\n    # 确定性\n    points2 = sample_price_history(\n        seed=\"mock:x-1\",\n        current_price=500,\n        days=14,\n        today=date(2026, 4, 21),\n    )\n    assert [p.price for p in points] == [p.price for p in points2]\n\n\ndef test_price_history_weekend_is_higher_than_weekday_same_seed() -> None:\n    # 2026-05-01 周五开始 14 天，里边既有周末也有劳动节\n    points = sample_price_history(\n        seed=\"mock:weekend-test\",\n        current_price=400,\n        days=14,\n        today=date(2026, 5, 1),\n    )\n    legal = [p.price for p in points if p.is_holiday]\n    weekday = [\n        p.price for p in points if not p.is_weekend and not p.is_holiday\n    ]\n    assert legal, \"样本里应有法定假日点\"\n    assert weekday, \"样本里应有平日点\"\n    # 节假日的峰值价 > 平日均值\n    assert max(legal) > sum(weekday) / len(weekday)\n\n\ndef test_price_history_peak_multiplier_propagates_future() -> None:\n    points = sample_price_history(\n        seed=\"mock:peak\",\n        current_price=500,\n        days=10,\n        today=date(2026, 4, 21),\n        expected_peak_multiplier=1.8,\n    )\n    future = [p.price for p in points if p.date > date(2026, 4, 21)]\n    past = [p.price for p in points if p.date < date(2026, 4, 21)]\n    assert future\n    assert past\n    assert max(future) > max(past) * 1.2\n\n\ndef test_api_price_history_endpoint(client: TestClient) -> None:\n    #  "contents": "import { apiFetch } from './client'\nimport type { ItineraryResponse } from './types'\n\nexport interface ItineraryGenerateParams {\n  city: string\n  check_in: string\n  check_out: string\n  must_visit?: string[]\n  themes?: string[]\n  hotel_name?: string\n  hotel_address?: string\n}\n\nfunction toQuery(params: ItineraryGenerateParams): URLSearchParams {\n  const q = new URLSearchParams()\n  q.set('city', params.city)\n  q.set('check_in', params.check_in)\n  q.set('check_out', params.check_out)\n  params.must_visit?.forEach((m) => m && q.append('must_visit', m))\n  params.themes?.forEach((t) => t && q.append('themes', t))\n  if (params.hotel_name) q.set('hotel_name', params.hotel_name)\n  if (params.hotel_address) q.set('hotel_address', params.hotel_address)\n  return q\n}\n\nexport function generateItinerary(\n  params: ItineraryGenerateParams,\n): Promise<ItineraryResponse> {\n  return apiFetch<ItineraryResponse>(\n    `/api/itineraries/generate?${toQuery(params).toString()}`,\n  )\n}\n\nfunction buildExportUrl(path: string, params: ItineraryGenerateParams): string {\n  const base = (import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '').replace(/\\/+$/, '')\n  return `${base}${path}?${toQuery(params).toString()}`\n}\n\nexport function itineraryMarkdownUrl(params: ItineraryGenerateParams): string {\n  return buildExportUrl('/api/itineraries/export.md', params)\n}\n\nexport function itineraryPdfUrl(params: ItineraryGenerateParams): string {\n  return buildExportUrl('/api/itineraries/export.pdf', params)\n}\n\nexport async function downloadItineraryMarkdown(\n  params: ItineraryGenerateParams,\n): Promise<void> {\n  await triggerDownload(itineraryMarkdownUrl(params), inferFilename(params, 'md'))\n}\n\nexport async function downloadItineraryPdf(\n  params: ItineraryGenerateParams,\n): Promise<void> {\n  await triggerDownload(itineraryPdfUrl(params), inferFilename(params, 'pdf'))\n}\n\nfunction inferFilename(params: ItineraryGenerateParams, ext: string): string {\n  return `${params.city}_${params.check_in}_${params.check_out}_itinerary.${ext}`\n}\n\nasync function triggerDownload(url: string, filename: string): Promise<void> {\n  const resp = await fetch(url)\n  if (!resp.ok) {\n    const text = await resp.text().catch(() => '')\n    throw new Error(`下载失败：${resp.status} ${resp.statusText} ${text}`)\n  }\n  const blob = await resp.blob()\n  const href = URL.createObjectURL(blob)\n  const a = document.createElement('a')\n  a.href = href\n  a.download = filename\n  document.body.appendChild(a)\n  a.click()\n  a.remove()\n  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(href), 5_000)\n}\n"
}

 "contents": "import { useMemo } from 'react'\n\nimport type { PricePoint } from '@/api/types'\nimport { formatCNY } from '@/lib/utils'\n\ninterface PriceCurveProps {\n  points: PricePoint[]\n  currentPrice?: number | null\n  height?: number\n  expectedMultiplier?: number\n}\n\n/**\n * 纯 SVG 价格走势图——无第三方图表库依赖。\n *\n * 设计：\n * - 坐标轴：X 轴按日期（等距），Y 轴按价格（含 10% padding）\n * - 平日用折线，周末/节假日用圆点 + 悬停 tooltip 强调\n * - 今日用虚线标出，便于识别「我现在处于曲线哪里」\n */\nexport function PriceCurve({\n  points,\n  currentPrice,\n  height = 180,\n  expectedMultiplier,\n}: PriceCurveProps) {\n  const padding = { top: 12, right: 12, bottom: 28, left: 44 }\n\n  const geometry = useMemo(() => {\n    if (points.length === 0) return null\n    const prices = points.map((p) => p.price)\n    const min = Math.min(...prices) * 0.92\n    const max = Math.max(...prices) * 1.08\n    const width = 560\n    const innerW = width - padding.left - padding.right\n    const innerH = height - padding.top - padding.bottom\n    const xs = points.map((_, i) =>\n      points.length === 1 ? 0 : (i / (points.length - 1)) * innerW,\n    )\n    const ys = points.map(\n      (p) => innerH - ((p.price - min) / (max - min)) * innerH,\n    )\n    const path = points\n      .map((_, i) => `${i === 0 ? 'M' : 'L'} ${xs[i].toFixed(1)},${ys[i].toFixed(1)}`)\n      .join(' ')\n    return { xs, ys, min, max, width, innerW, innerH, path }\n  }, [points, height])\n\n  if (!geometry) {\n    return (\n      <div className=\"rounded-lg border border-dashed border-slate-200 p-6 text-center text-xs text-slate-400\">\n        暂无价格采样数据\n      </div>\n    )\n  }\n\n  const todayIndex = useMemo(() => {\n    const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)\n    return points.findIndex((p) => p.date === today)\n  }, [points])\n\n  const yAxisTicks = buildYTicks(geometry.min, geometry.max)\n  const ticks = [0, Math.floor(points.length / 2), points.length - 1].filter(\n    (v, i, arr) => arr.indexOf(v) === i,\n  )\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"relative\">\n      <svg\n        viewBox={`0 0 ${geometry.width} ${height}`}\n        width=\"100%\"\n        height={height}\n        preserveAspectRatio=\"none\"\n        className=\"overflow-visible\"\n      >\n        {yAxisTicks.map((tick) => {\n          const y =\n            padding.top +\n            geometry.innerH -\n            ((tick - geometry.min) / (geometry.max - geometry.min)) *\n              geometry.innerH\n          return (\n            <g key={tick}>\n              <line\n                x1={padding.left}\n                x2={geometry.width - padding.right}\n                y1={y}\n                y2={y}\n                stroke=\"#E5E7EB\"\n                strokeDasharray=\"2 2\"\n              />\n              <text\n                x={padding.left - 6}\n                y={y + 3}\n                textAnchor=\"end\"\n                className=\"fill-slate-400 text-[10px]\"\n              >\n                {formatCNY(tick)}\n              </text>\n            </g>\n          )\n        })}\n\n        <g transform={`translate(${padding.left}, ${padding.top})`}>\n          <path\n            d={geometry.path}\n            fill=\"none\"\n            stroke=\"#FF6900\"\n            strokeWidth={2}\n          />\n          {points.map((point, i) => {\n            const highlight = point.is_holiday || point.is_weekend\n            return (\n              <circle\n                key={`${point.date}-${i}`}\n                cx={geometry.xs[i]}\n                cy={geometry.ys[i]}\n                r={highlight ? 4.5 : 2.5}\n                fill={\n                  point.is_holiday\n                    ? '#DC2626'\n                    : point.is_weekend\n                      ? '#F59E0B'\n                      : '#FF6900'\n                }\n                stroke=\"white\"\n                strokeWidth={highlight ? 1.5 : 0.5}\n              >\n                <title>\n                  {point.date}\n                  {point.holiday_name_cn ? ` · ${point.holiday_name_cn}` : ''}\n                  {point.is_weekend && !point.is_holiday ? ' · 周末' : ''}\n                  {' · '}\n                  {formatCNY(point.price)}\n                </title>\n              </circle>\n            )\n          })}\n\n          {todayIndex >= 0 && (\n            <g>\n              <line\n                x1={geometry.xs[todayIndex]}\n                x2={geometry.xs[todayIndex]}\n                y1={0}\n                y2={geometry.innerH}\n                stroke=\"#2563EB\"\n                strokeDasharray=\"3 3\"\n              />\n              <text\n                x={geometry.xs[todayIndex]}\n                y={-2}\n                textAnchor=\"middle\"\n                className=\"fill-brand-600 text-[10px] font-semibold\"\n              >\n                今日\n              </text>\n            </g>\n          )}\n        </g>\n\n        <g>\n          {ticks.map((idx) => {\n            const x = padding.left + geometry.xs[idx]\n            return (\n              <text\n                key={idx}\n                x={x}\n                y={height - 10}\n                textAnchor=\"middle\"\n                className=\"fill-slate-400 text-[10px]\"\n              >\n                {formatDateTick(points[idx].date)}\n              </text>\n            )\n          })}\n        </g>\n      </svg>\n\n      <div className=\"mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-[11px] text-slate-500\">\n        <LegendDot color=\"#FF6900\" label=\"平日价格\" />\n        <LegendDot color=\"#F59E0B\" label=\"周末\" />\n        <LegendDot color=\"#DC2626\" label=\"法定假日\" />\n        {currentPrice != null && (\n          <span className=\"ml-auto\">\n            当前：<strong className=\"text-brand-600\">{formatCNY(currentPrice)}</strong>\n          </span>\n        )}\n        {expectedMultiplier && expectedMultiplier > 1.05 && (\n          <span className=\"text-amber-600\">\n            节假日预期 ×{expectedMultiplier.toFixed(2)}\n          </span>\n        )}\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\nfunction LegendDot({ color, label }: { color: string; label: string }) {\n  return (\n    <span className=\"inline-flex items-center gap-1\">\n      <span\n        className=\"inline-block h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full\"\n        style={{ backgroundColor: color }}\n      />\n      {label}\n    </span>\n  )\n}\n\nfunction formatDateTick(iso: string): string {\n  const d = new Date(iso)\n  const m = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')\n  const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')\n  return `${m}-${day}`\n}\n\nfunction buildYTicks(min: number, max: number): number[] {\n  const range = max - min\n  if (range <= 0) return [min]\n  const step = Math.ceil(range / 3 / 10) * 10\n  const base = Math.ceil(min / step) * step\n  const ticks: number[] = []\n  for (let v = base; v <= max; v += step) {\n    ticks.push(v)\n  }\n  if (ticks.length === 0) {\n    ticks.push(min, max)\n  }\n  return ticks\n}\n"
}

'整体好评' : sentiment <= -0.3 ? '偏差评' : '中性'\n  const sentimentColor =\n    sentiment >= 0.3\n      ? 'text-emerald-600'\n      : sentiment <= -0.3\n        ? 'text-red-600'\n        : 'text-slate-600'\n\n  return (\n    <section className=\"card p-5\">\n      <header className=\"mb-3 flex items-start justify-between gap-2\">\n        <div>\n          <h3 className=\"text-base font-semibold text-slate-900\">社媒洞察</h3>\n          <p className=\"mt-0.5 text-xs text-slate-500\">\n            {notes.length} 条笔记 · {POWERED_BY_LABEL[insights.powered_by] ?? insights.powered_by}\n          </p>\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"flex flex-col items-end gap-1\">\n          <span className={`chip font-semibold ${sentimentColor}`}>\n            {sentimentLabel} {sentiment >= 0 ? '+' : ''}\n            {sentiment.toFixed(2)}\n          </span>\n          <span className=\"text-[11px] text-slate-400\">\n            来源：{SOURCE_LABEL[provider] ?? provider}\n          </span>\n        </div>\n      </header>\n\n      {warning && (\n        <div className=\"mb-3 rounded-lg border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-amber-800\">\n          {warning}\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {insights.summary && (\n        <p className=\"mb-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-slate-700\">\n          <span className=\"mr-1 font-semibold text-slate-900\">AI 一句话：</span>\n          {insights.summary}\n        </p>\n      )}\n\n      <div className=\"grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2\">\n        <InsightList\n          title=\"亮点 / 推荐\"\n          items={insights.highlights}\n          accent=\"emerald\"\n          empty=\"暂无\"\n        />\n        <InsightList\n          title=\"吐槽 / 避雷\"\n          items={insights.complaints}\n          accent=\"rose\"\n          empty=\"暂无\"\n        />\n      </div>\n\n      {insights.tags.length > 0 && (\n        <div className=\"mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-1\">\n          {insights.tags.map((t) => (\n            <span key={t} className=\"chip bg-brand-50 text-brand-700 ring-brand-200\">\n              {t}\n            </span>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {notes.length > 0 && (\n        <details className=\"mt-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/60\">\n          <summary className=\"cursor-pointer px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-500 select-none\">\n            展开笔记原文（{notes.length} 条）\n          </summary>\n          <ul className=\"space-y-2 border-t border-slate-100 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-600\">\n            {notes.slice(0, 6).map((n) => (\n              <li key={n.note_id} className=\"leading-relaxed\">\n                <span className=\"mr-1 text-slate-400\">[{SOURCE_LABEL[n.source] ?? n.source}]</span>\n                {n.title && <span className=\"font-semibold\">{n.title} · </span>}\n                {n.content.slice(0, 160)}\n                {n.content.length > 160 ? '…' : ''}\n                {n.url && (\n                  <a\n                    href={n.url}\n                    target=\"_blank\"\n                    rel=\"noreferrer\"\n                    className=\"ml-1 text-brand-600 hover:underline\"\n                  >\n                    原文\n                  </a>\n                )}\n              </li>\n            ))}\n          </ul>\n        </details>\n      )}\n    </section>\n  )\n}\n\nfunction InsightList({\n  title,\n  items,\n  accent,\n  empty,\n}: {\n  title: string\n  items: string[]\n  accent: 'emerald' | 'rose'\n  empty: string\n}) {\n  const badge =\n    accent === 'emerald'\n      ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 ring-emerald-200'\n      : 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 ring-rose-200'\n  return (\n    <div>\n      <h4 className=\"mb-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500\">{title}</h4>\n      {items.length === 0 ? (\n        <p className=\"text-xs text-slate-400\">{empty}</p>\n      ) : (\n        <ul className=\"space-y-1\">\n          {items.map((item) => (\n            <li key={item}>\n              <span className={`chip ${badge}`}>{item}</span>\n            </li>\n          ))}\n        </ul>\n      )}\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n"
}

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\Hotel Manger\\frontend\\nginx.conf",
 "contents": "# Holiday Hotel Planner — 前端 nginx 配置（生产镜像 target=prod 使用）。\n#\n# 关键点：\n#  - SPA fallback：所有未命中文件的请求走 index.html，由前端路由接管；\n#  - /api/* 反向代理到后端 service（docker 内网 DNS 解析 `backend`）；\n#  - 关闭 proxy buffering，避免 LangGraph SSE 被缓冲；\n#  - gzip 基础优化。\n\nserver {\n    listen       80;\n    listen       [::]:80;\n    server_name  _;\n\n    root   /usr/share/nginx/html;\n    index  index.html;\n\n    # 静态资源\n    location / {\n        try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;\n    }\n\n    # 前端静态资源的强缓存（hashed 文件）\n    location ~* \\.(?:js|css|woff2?|ttf|otf|svg|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|webp|ico)$ {\n        expires 7d;\n        add_header Cache-Control \"public, max-age=604800, immutable\";\n        try_files $uri =404;\n    }\n\n    # 后端 API 反代 —— compose 网络内 backend:8000\n    location /api/ {\n        proxy_pass         http://backend:8000;\n        proxy_http_version 1.1;\n        proxy_set_header   Host              $host;\n        proxy_set_header   X-Real-IP         $remote_addr;\n        proxy_set_header   X-Forwarded-For   $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;\n        proxy_set_header   X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;\n        proxy_set_header   Connection        \"\";\n\n        # SSE / 长连接：关闭缓冲 + 延长超时\n        proxy_buffering    off;\n        proxy_cache        off;\n        proxy_read_timeout 24h;\n        proxy_send_timeout 24h;\n    }\n\n    # gzip\n    gzip            on;\n    gzip_comp_level 6;\n    gzip_min_length 1024;\n    gzip_types      text/plain text/css text/javascript application/javascript\n                    application/json application/xml application/wasm image/svg+xml;\n    gzip_vary       on;\n\n    client_max_body_size 16m;\n}\n"
}

### 🤖 Agent

Now the production overlay file.

 I'm realizing the bind-mount strategy might cause issues—while it won't interfere with the Node runtime in the system paths, it will shadow the Python dependencies installed during the image build, since the host's `/app/backend` directory will overlay whatever was set up in the container.

Actually, that's fine because the Python packages are installed to `/usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages`, not into `/app/backend`, so imports will still resolve correctly even with the bind-mount in place.

There's a subtler concern though: when the backend code walks up the directory tree to find config files, it needs to land on the right paths—the bind-mount ensures `/app/backend` maps to the host's source, and from there it can correctly locate `/app/mcp/servers.json` through the read-only mount.

For the uvicorn reload configuration, specifying `--reload-dir /app/backend/app` is better than letting it watch the entire `/app/backend` directory, since that would include `.venv` on Windows hosts and potentially trigger excessive reload cycles. However, I can't use `--reload-dir` to watch the MCP config since uvicorn only reloads on Python code changes anyway.

Now I need to verify all the environment variables match what's defined in the config file. Going through the list: app environment, CORS origins, LLM settings, AMap key, database and Redis URLs, hotel provider configuration, Booking API credentials and cache TTL, Qunar settings and cache TTL—all accounted for. I'm also passing through `AMAP_TRANSPORT` and `SOCIAL_TRANSPORT` which the factories pull directly from the environment.

`!override` is the right tag for replace (not `!reset`). Let me fix the prod overlay.

 So `!override` is the right approach here—it replaces the entire volumes list rather than just clearing it. For the production overlay, I'll use `!override` on the backend volumes to swap in just the mcp and data volumes, and either `!override` with an empty list or `!reset` for the frontend to remove volumes entirely.

On the ports front, I need to be careful. The dev base has `5173:5173` mapped, but the production Dockerfile only exposes port 80 for nginx. If I don't override, both port mappings would be active—the container would try to listen on both 5173 and 80. Since nothing's actually listening on 5173 inside the container, traffic to host port 5173 would just get refused, but the port would still be occupied on the host. That could conflict if someone's running dev locally. So I definitely need to `!override` the frontend ports to replace it with just `8080:80`.

### 一键启动

```bash
# 首次：拷 env（可选，不拷也能跑）
Copy-Item .env.example .env

# 开发模式
docker compose up --build

# 生产模式（nginx + 多 worker）
docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --build
```

### 核心改动一览

| 文件 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `backend/Dockerfile` | 基于 `python:3.11-slim`，通过 NodeSource 装 **Node 20**（为了让 MCP server 能通过 `npx` 拉起），构建上下文改为仓库根以便一起 `COPY backend/` + `COPY mcp/`；加了 `HEALTHCHECK` |
| `frontend/Dockerfile` | 多阶段（deps → dev → build → prod）；prod 用 `nginx:1.27-alpine` |
| `frontend/nginx.conf` | SPA fallback、`/api/` 反代 `backend:8000`、SSE 关缓冲、静态资源强缓存 + gzip |
| `frontend/vite.config.ts` / `.js` | 新增 `VITE_DEV_PROXY_TARGET`，让容器内 vite 代理指向 `http://backend:8000`，同时浏览器仍走相对路径 |
| `docker-compose.yml` | 默认 dev 模式：bind-mount 热更新、named volume 持久化 SQLite、健康检查、`env_file required:false`、显式枚举所有 backend env |
| `docker-compose.prod.yml` | 生产 overlay：`--workers 2` + 多 worker、`nginx` target、用 `!override` 干净地替换 dev 的 bind-mount/ports；可选 **PostgreSQL** / **Redis** 通过 `--profile postgres` / `--profile redis` 启用 |
| `.dockerignore` + `frontend/.dockerignore` | 屏蔽 `.venv`/`node_modules`/`dist`/`.env` 等 |
| `.env.example` | 追加 `BACKEND_PORT` / `FRONTEND_PORT` / `FRONTEND_PROD_PORT` / `BACKEND_WORKERS` / `POSTGRES_*` 等部署变量，并标注 SQLite 容器内的绝对路径写法 |
| `README.md` | 新增「部署说明」大节，涵盖一键启动、生产 overlay、Postgres/Redis profiles、端口/卷一览、运维命令、排查清单，以及单独一节讲 **MCP server 进程管理** |

### MCP server 进程管理（关键设计）

MCP server 不作为独立容器启动：backend 进程通过 `mcp` Python SDK 以 **stdio 子进程**按需拉起 `npx -y @amap/amap-maps-mcp-server` / `rednote-mcp`，因此：

1. backend 镜像内置 Node 20，容器内可直接 `npx`；  
2. `mcp/servers.json` 通过镜像 `COPY mcp /app/mcp` + 绑定挂载同时落到容器的 `/app/mcp` —— 和代码里 `Path(__file__).parents[4] / "mcp" / "servers.json"` 的查找路径对齐；  
3. 子进程生命周期跟随 backend 容器，`docker compose down` 即清理；  
4. MCP 挂掉时自动降级：`AMAP_TRANSPORT=auto` → HTTP 直连；`SOCIAL_TRANSPORT=auto` → DuckDuckGo 联网搜索；`rednote` MCP 默认 `disabled`，需要手动开。

端口 8000 上同时有两个 uvicorn 在监听：

### 已做的修复

- Hotel 后端改监听 `***REDACTED-IP***:8001`。
- Vite 通过 `VITE_DEV_PROXY_TARGET=http://***REDACTED-IP***:8001` 重启，`/api/*` 现在代理到 8001。

- 后端 Hotel：<http://***REDACTED-IP***:8001/docs>、<http://***REDACTED-IP***:8001/api/health>
- EDM 后端仍保持在 8000，不受影响

### 建议
如果以后想继续用 8000，可以先把 EDM 的 uvicorn 停掉再启动 Hotel；或者在 `.env` 里把 `BACKEND_PORT=8001` 固化，避免端口撞车。

## 问题原因

前端 `/api/*` 请求 404 不是代码 bug，而是**端口被另一个项目占用了**。

1. 本项目后端的 `/api/hotels/search`、`/api/holidays/range`、`/api/holidays/peak` 路由定义都在，代码没问题：

   - `backend/app/api/hotels.py` 的 `@router.get("/search")` 存在
2. 当前监听 `***REDACTED-IP***:8000` 的进程**不是**本项目，而是另一个 EDM 项目的 uvicorn（PID 46048 / 31948）：

```text
"D:\文档\Cursor\EDM\edm-backend\venv\Scripts\python.exe"
"D:\文档\Cursor\EDM\edm-backend\venv\Scripts\uvicorn.exe" app.main:app --reload --port 8000
```

3. 本项目前一次通过 Cursor 终端启动的 `uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000`（PID 48228）已经在 17:37:25 退出（`exit_code=1`）。
4. Vite 代理默认指向 `http://***REDACTED-IP***:8000`（见 `frontend/vite.config.ts`），于是前端所有 `/api/*` 都被转发到那个 EDM 后端，那个服务里自然没有 hotels/holidays，所以统一 404。连 `/api/health` 也 404，就能验证这一点。

## 两种解决办法（任选一个）

### 方法 A（推荐）：杀掉占用 8000 的 EDM 进程，重新启动本项目后端

你可以手动在 PowerShell 里执行：

```powershell
Stop-Process -Id 46048,31948 -Force
cd "d:\文档\Cursor\Hotel Manger\backend"
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
```

### 方法 B：让本项目换一个端口，不影响 EDM

例如改用 8765 端口：

1. 在 `frontend/` 目录创建或编辑 `.env.development`（或 `.env.local`）：

```bash
VITE_DEV_PROXY_TARGET=http://***REDACTED-IP***:8765
```

2. 重启前端 dev server 让代理生效：

```powershell
cd "d:\文档\Cursor\Hotel Manger\frontend"
npm run dev
```

3. 启动后端到 8765：

```powershell
cd "d:\文档\Cursor\Hotel Manger\backend"
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8765
```

None:\n    s = _scalar(v)\n    if s is None:\n        return None\n    try:\n        return int(float(s))\n    except (TypeError, ValueError):\n        return None\n\n\ndef _maybe_float(v: Any) -> float | None:\n    s = _scalar(v)\n    if s is None:\n        return None\n    try:\n        return float(s)\n    except (TypeError, ValueError):\n        return None\n\n\ndef _strip_html(text: str) -> str:\n    if not text:\n        return \"\"\n    return _HTML_TAG_RE.sub(\"\", text).strip()\n\n\ndef _haversine_m(a: GeoPoint, b: GeoPoint) -> int:\n    \"\"\"两个 WGS84 坐标间地表距离（米），精度够用。\"\"\"\n    r = 6371000.0\n    lat1 = math.radians(a.lat)\n    lat2 = math.radians(b.lat)\n    dlat = lat2 - lat1\n    dlng = math.radians(b.lng - a.lng)\n    h = math.sin(dlat / 2) ** 2 + math.cos(lat1) * math.cos(lat2) * math.sin(dlng / 2) ** 2\n    return int(2 * r * math.asin(math.sqrt(h)))\n"

 "contents": "\"\"\"选择并构造 MapsClient。\n\n策略（按 `GOOGLE_MAPS_TRANSPORT` env 决定）：\n- `auto`（默认）：优先 MCP；失败时记录 warning 后回退 HTTP；\n- `mcp`：强制 MCP，失败直接抛；\n- `http`：直接 HTTP；\n- 未配置 `GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY` 时所有模式都会抛 `ValueError`，由上层处理。\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport logging\nimport os\nfrom typing import Literal\n\nfrom app.core.config import Settings, get_settings\nfrom app.providers.maps.base import MapsClient\nfrom app.providers.maps.google_http import GoogleMapsHttpClient\nfrom app.providers.maps.google_mcp import GoogleMapsMCPClient\nfrom app.providers.maps.mcp_client import MCPClient, MCPUnavailable\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\nTransport = Literal[\"auto\", \"mcp\", \"http\"]\n\n\nclass CompositeGoogleMapsClient:\n    \"\"\"auto 模式下的组合 client：首选 MCP，异常时降级 HTTP。\"\"\"\n\n    name: str = \"google-maps-composite\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self, primary: GoogleMapsMCPClient, fallback: GoogleMapsHttpClient\n    ) -> None:\n        self._primary = primary\n        self._fallback = fallback\n        self._primary_disabled = False\n\n    async def aclose(self) -> None:\n        try:\n            await self._primary.aclose()\n        finally:\n            await self._fallback.aclose()\n\n    async def geocode(self, address, city=None):  # type: ignore[override]\n        return await self._dispatch(\n            \"geocode\", lambda c: c.geocode(address, city=city)\n        )\n\n    async def around_search(self, center, radius_m=3000, keywords=None):  # type: ignore[override]\n        return await self._dispatch(\n            \"around_search\",\n            lambda c: c.around_search(center, radius_m=radius_m, keywords=keywords),\n        )\n\n    async def direction_driving(self, origin, destination):  # type: ignore[override]\n        return await self._dispatch(\n            \"direction_driving\", lambda c: c.direction_driving(origin, destination)\n        )\n\n    async def _dispatch(self, name: str, fn):\n        if not self._primary_disabled:\n            try:\n                return await fn(self._primary)\n            except MCPUnavailable as exc:\n                logger.warning(\"MCP 调用 %s 失败，永久回退 HTTP：%s\", name, exc)\n                self._primary_disabled = True\n            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001\n                logger.warning(\"MCP %s 失败，此次回退 HTTP：%s\", name, exc)\n        return await fn(self._fallback)\n\n\ndef build_default_maps_client(settings: Settings | None = None) -> MapsClient:\n    settings = settings or get_settings()\n    transport = (\n        os.environ.get(\"GOOGLE_MAPS_TRANSPORT\")\n        or getattr(settings, \"google_maps_transport\", \"auto\")\n        or \"auto\"\n    ).lower()\n    if transport not in (\"auto\", \"mcp\", \"http\"):\n        logger.warning(\n            \"GOOGLE_MAPS_TRANSPORT=%s 未识别，回退到 auto\", transport\n        )\n        transport = \"auto\"\n    if not settings.google_maps_api_key:\n        raise ValueError(\n            \"未配置 GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY；请在 `.env` 中设置 \"\n            \"`GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=your_key`。\"\n        )\n\n    http_client = GoogleMapsHttpClient(settings.google_maps_api_key)\n\n    if transport == \"http\":\n        return http_client\n\n    try:\n        mcp = MCPClient.from_config(\"google-maps\", settings)\n    except MCPUnavailable as exc:\n        if transport == \"mcp\":\n            raise\n        logger.info(\"MCP 不可用（%s），maps client 回退 HTTP\", exc)\n        return http_client\n\n    google_mcp = GoogleMapsMCPClient(mcp)\n    if transport == \"mcp\":\n        return google_mcp\n    return CompositeGoogleMapsClient(primary=google_mcp, fallback=http_client)\n"
}

先把两件事说清楚：**Google Maps 的配置流程**、以及**国内访问 Google Maps 的现实问题**。然后根据你的情况给出后续动作选项。

## 一、Google Maps 详细配置（已就绪，只差你申请 Key）

### 步骤 1：创建 Google Cloud 项目

1. 打开 <https://console.cloud.google.com/>，用 Google 账号登录。
2. 页面顶部点项目下拉 → **新建项目** → 随便起个名字，比如 `hotel-planner`。
3. 进入 **Billing（结算）** → 给项目绑定一张信用卡（Visa/MasterCard）。
   - Google 每月给 **$200 免费额度**（约 2.8 万次 Geocoding 请求），MVP 阶段绝对用不完。
   - 没绑卡 → 所有 API 直接返回 `BILLING_NOT_ENABLED`，不会计费但也用不了。

### 步骤 2：启用 4 个 API

左侧菜单 → **APIs & Services → Library**，搜索并逐个点 **ENABLE**：

| API | 给谁用 | 代码里对应 |
|---|---|---|
| **Geocoding API** | 后端 | `/api/maps/geocode`、`GoogleMapsHttpClient.geocode` |
| **Places API**（选 "Places API" 经典版，**不是** "Places API (New)"）| 后端 | `/api/maps/around_search` |
| **Directions API** | 后端 | `/api/maps/directions` |
| **Maps JavaScript API** | 前端 | `MapView.tsx` 渲染底图 |

> ⚠️ 一定要选**经典版 Places API**，新版 Places API (New) 的 `/nearbysearch` 协议完全不一样，当前 `google_http.py` 走的是旧版 `/place/nearbysearch/json`。

### 步骤 3：创建两个 API Key

**APIs & Services → Credentials → + CREATE CREDENTIALS → API key**，建两个：

**Key A（给后端用，服务端调用）**
- 点新建的 key → **Edit API key**
- **Application restrictions** → 选 `IP addresses` → 填你的服务器公网 IP（本地开发可先选 `None`）
- **API restrictions** → 选 `Restrict key` → 勾上 `Geocoding API` / `Places API` / `Directions API`
- Save → 复制字符串 → 填到 `.env` 的 `GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=...`

**Key B（给前端用，浏览器里暴露）**
- 同上新建第二个 key
- **Application restrictions** → 选 `HTTP referrers` → 加 `http://localhost:5173/*`、`http://localhost:8080/*`，生产环境再加你的域名
- **API restrictions** → 只勾 `Maps JavaScript API`
- Save → 复制 → 填到 `.env` 的 `VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=...`

> 为啥要分两个 key：前端 key 一定会被浏览器 F12 看到，被爬去刷量；所以前端 key 要加 referer 限制 + 限定只能调 JS API，后端 key 加 IP 限制 + 限定能调 3 个 Web Service API。

### 步骤 4：验证

填完 `.env` 后：

```powershell
docker compose up --build
# 或本机分别启动
```

浏览器打开 <http://localhost:8000/api/maps/geocode?address=Forbidden%20City&city=Beijing>，应返回 `{"poi": {...}}`；打开 <http://localhost:5173>，地图页应渲染出真正的 Google 底图。

## 二、国内用 Google Maps 的坑（务必知道）

这是**无法在代码层绕过**的硬限制：

| 限制 | 现象 | 影响 |
|---|---|---|
| **前端 JS API 被墙** | 浏览器加载 `maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js` 会超时 | 国内用户打开前端页面地图一片灰，Console 报 `ERR_CONNECTION_TIMED_OUT` |
| **服务端 Web Service 同样被墙** | 国内云服务器（阿里云/腾讯云）直连 `maps.googleapis.com` 会偶发超时 | 后端 `/api/maps/geocode` 返回 502 |
| **中国境内 POI 数据稀** | 即使能访问，中国大陆的 POI 覆盖远不如高德 | Places Nearby 返回结果少、翻译差 |
| **地图底图受 GFW 干扰** | 即使 JS API 加载成功，瓦片图 (`maps.gstatic.com`) 也会时断时续 | 地图闪烁、加载缓慢 |

### 两种实际可行的解法

**解法 A：仅在海外服务器 / 有科学上网环境下用 Google Maps**
- 适合：海外用户、跨境业务、开发机有代理
- 成本：零（当前代码就是这套）

**解法 B：切回高德 / 双 provider 可切换**
- 适合：服务主要面向中国大陆用户，服务器部署在国内
- 成本：需要我把代码改回去（或做成双路切换）

---

duration_s=_maybe_int(path.get(\"duration\")) or 0,\n            tolls=_maybe_float(path.get(\"tolls\")),\n            steps=steps,\n            origin=origin,\n            destination=destination,\n        )\n\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # internals\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    async def _get_json(self, path: str, params: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        resp = await self._client.get(path, params=params)\n        resp.raise_for_status()\n        data = resp.json()\n        if str(data.get(\"status\")) != \"1\":\n            info = data.get(\"info\") or data.get(\"infocode\") or \"unknown\"\n            raise AmapHttpError(f\"高德 API 返回失败：{info}\")\n        return data\n\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# helpers（也被 amap_mcp.py 复用）\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef _parse_location(raw: Any) -> GeoPoint | None:\n    \"\"\"高德返回 `\"lng,lat\"` 字符串 → GeoPoint。\"\"\"\n    if not raw or not isinstance(raw, str) or \",\" not in raw:\n        return None\n    lng, lat = raw.split(\",\", 1)\n    try:\n        return GeoPoint(lng=float(lng), lat=float(lat))\n    except ValueError:\n        return None\n\n\ndef _scalar(v: Any) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"高德部分字段在无数据时返回空 list；归一为 None。\"\"\"\n    if v is None:\n        return None\n    if isinstance(v, list):\n        return None if not v else str(v[0]) or None\n    s = str(v).strip()\n    return s or None\n\n\ndef _maybe_int(v: Any) -> int | None:\n    s = _scalar(v)\n    if s is None:\n        return None\n    try:\n        return int(float(s))\n    except (TypeError, ValueError):\n        return None\n\n\ndef _maybe_float(v: Any) -> float | None:\n    s = _scalar(v)\n    if s is None:\n        return None\n    try:\n        return float(s)\n    except (TypeError, ValueError):\n        return None\n"

------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # internals\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    async def _call(self, tool: str, args: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        try:\n            payload = await self._mcp.call_tool(tool, args)\n        except MCPToolError as exc:\n            raise AmapHttpError(f\"MCP tool )\n\n\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Amap (高德)\n# ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef '#f97316' : '#fff'}\n                stroke={m.highlight ? '#ea580c' : '#0284c7'}\n                strokeWidth=\"2\"\n              />\n              <text\n                x={p.x + 10}\n                y={p.y + 4}\n                className=\"fill-slate-700\"\n                fontSize=\"10\"\n              >\n                {m.label}\n              </text>\n            </g>\n          )\n        })}\n      </svg>\n      <div className=\"pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-3 rounded-md bg-white/80 px-2 py-1 text-[11px] text-slate-600 backdrop-blur\">\n        Map Preview · 未配置 {envVarName}，展示 SVG 占位图\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\nfunction computeBBox(\n  center: { lng: number; lat: number } | undefined,\n  markers: MapMarker[],\n) {\n  const points = [...markers]\n  if (center) points.push({ id: 'center', lng: center.lng, lat: center.lat, label: '' })\n  if (points.length === 0) {\n    return { minLng: 0, maxLng: 1, minLat: 0, maxLat: 1 }\n  }\n  const lngs = points.map((p) => p.lng)\n  const lats = points.map((p) => p.lat)\n  const minLng = Math.min(...lngs)\n  const maxLng = Math.max(...lngs)\n  const minLat = Math.min(...lats)\n  const maxLat = Math.max(...lats)\n  const padLng = (maxLng - minLng) * 0.2 || 0.01\n  const padLat = (maxLat - minLat) * 0.2 || 0.01\n  return {\n    minLng: minLng - padLng,\n    maxLng: maxLng + padLng,\n    minLat: minLat - padLat,\n    maxLat: maxLat + padLat,\n  }\n}\n\nexport function offerToMarker(offer: HotelOffer, highlight = false): MapMarker {\n  return {\n    id: `${offer.provider}:${offer.hotel_id}`,\n    lng: offer.location.lng,\n    lat: offer.location.lat,\n    label: offer.name,\n    highlight,\n  }\n}\n"

 "new_string": "在 `.env` 里按需填入 `LLM_API_KEY` 与所选地图 provider 的 key，留空时\n后端对应 client 会自动降级（map 工具直接报错给 Agent、Agent 节点会用 `CITY_CENTERS` 内置兜底，\n没有 `LLM_API_KEY` 时行程 Agent 会退回 heuristic 实现），不会 crash 启动。\n\n### 地图 Provider 二选一\n\n| 维度 | Google Maps（海外默认） | 高德 Amap（国内推荐） |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| 后端 provider env | `MAPS_PROVIDER=google` | `MAPS_PROVIDER=amap` |\n| 前端 provider env | `VITE_MAPS_PROVIDER=google` | `VITE_MAPS_PROVIDER=amap` |\n| 后端 API key | `GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY` | `AMAP_KEY` |\n| 前端 API key | `VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY` | `VITE_AMAP_JS_KEY` + `VITE_AMAP_SECURITY_CODE` |\n| transport 切换 | `GOOGLE_MAPS_TRANSPORT=auto\\|mcp\\|http` | `AMAP_TRANSPORT=auto\\|mcp\\|http` |\n| MCP server | `@modelcontextprotocol/server-google-maps` | `@amap/amap-maps-mcp-server` |\n| 适合场景 | 部署在海外 / 服务海外用户 | 部署在国内 / 服务大陆用户（无墙问题、POI 覆盖密） |\n| 坐标系 | WGS-84 | GCJ-02（前端 AMap SDK 会自动处理） |\n\n切换 provider 只需要改 `.env` 里的 `MAPS_PROVIDER` + `VITE_MAPS_PROVIDER` 并填好对应 key，\n前后端代码不用动。两套 provider 的 SDK 都在依赖里，前端会在运行时按 `VITE_MAPS_PROVIDER` 决定\n加载哪一套 JS 资源（另一套不会产生网络请求）。\n\n**拿 key 的入口**\n\n- Google Maps：<https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials>，启用 Geocoding API /\n  Places API (Legacy) / Directions API / Maps JavaScript API；建议后端 key 加 IP 限制、\n  前端 key 加 HTTP referer 限制。\n- 高德 Amap：<https://console.amap.com/dev/key/app>，创建两个 key：\n  - 服务类型选 **「Web 服务」** → 作为 `AMAP_KEY`（后端用）。\n  - 服务类型选 **「Web 端（JS API）」** → 作为 `VITE_AMAP_JS_KEY`；2021-12-02 之后\n    高德强制要求同时申请**「安全密钥」**，需要把它填到 `VITE_AMAP_SECURITY_CODE`。"

## 现在你要做的配置

当前 `.env` 已经把 `MAPS_PROVIDER` / `VITE_MAPS_PROVIDER` 默认设成 **`amap`**（国内推荐），只需要去高德开放平台申请 key，替换 3 处 `REPLACE_ME_*` 就能跑起来。

### 高德 Key 申请（完整流程）

**Step 1：注册/登录**
- 打开 <https://console.amap.com/dev/key/app>
- 用手机号 / 微信登录
- 首次使用需要完成**开发者认证**（个人认证：身份证号 + 姓名；企业认证：营业执照）——2 分钟自动审核

**Step 2：创建应用**
- 左侧 **应用管理 → 我的应用 → 创建新应用**
- 填应用名（随便，比如 `hotel-planner`），应用类型选 `其他`

**Step 3：在应用下加两个 Key**（必须分开加，类型不同）

在应用卡片上点 **+ 添加**：

**Key A — 给后端用（Web 服务）**
- 服务平台选 **「Web 服务」**
- 白名单可留空，或填你服务器公网 IP
- 提交 → 页面会生成 32 位 key → 复制 → 填到 `.env` 的 `AMAP_KEY=...`

**Key B — 给前端用（Web 端 JS API）**
- 回到应用页再次 **+ 添加**
- 服务平台选 **「Web 端（JS API）」**
- **开启「安全密钥」**（2021-12-02 起高德强制，不开就报 `USERKEY_PLAT_NOMATCH`）
- 域名白名单填本地和生产域（多个用回车分隔）：
  ```
  localhost
  ***REDACTED-IP***
  yourdomain.com
  ```
- 提交 → 页面会显示**两个字符串**：`key` 和 `jscode`（安全密钥）
  - `key` → 填到 `.env` 的 `VITE_AMAP_JS_KEY=...`
  - `jscode` → 填到 `.env` 的 `VITE_AMAP_SECURITY_CODE=...`

**Step 4：确认额度**
- 个人开发者免费额度：地理编码 **5000 次/日**、Web 服务其他接口 **5000 次/日**、JS API **3 万次/日** —— MVP 完全够用
- 不需要绑卡
- 用超了直接返回 `10044 (USER_DAILY_QUERY_OVER_LIMIT)`，不会偷偷扣钱

**Step 5：启动验证**

```powershell
docker compose up --build
# 或本机：
# cd backend; .\.venv\Scripts\uvicorn.exe app.main:app --reload --port 8000
# cd frontend; npm run dev
```

打开 <http://localhost:8000/api/maps/geocode?address=故宫博物院&city=北京>，应返回 `{"poi": {"name": "...", "location": {"lng":116.3972..., "lat":39.9170...}}}`。

打开 <http://localhost:5173>，地图页应渲染出高德底图，marker/圆环都正常。

问题找到了：`Settings.env_file=".env"` 是相对路径，在 `backend/` 目录下跑 python 时找的是 `backend/.env` 而不是仓库根的 `.env`。docker compose 场景下 env 是直接注入容器的环境变量，不走 `.env` 读取，所以没暴露这个 bug。

我把 config 改成用绝对路径同时读「仓库根 + backend」两个 `.env`。

 I see the issue now — pydantic-settings is reading from the `.env` file in the backend directory, but our actual environment file is at the repository root. The config is set to look for `.env` relative to where the code runs, which is why it's not finding the `amap_key` and defaulting to Google instead.

The cleanest fix is to update the config to check both the current directory and the parent directory for `.env` files, with the right priority order so that a backend-level `.env` would override the root one if it exists. Since users typically run uvicorn from the backend directory, I need to structure the paths so they resolve correctly from that working directory.

Updating config.py...

- 🔧 **Read** `{ "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\Hotel Manger\\backend\\app\\core\\config.py" }`
- 🔧 **StrReplace**

```json
{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\Hotel Manger\\backend\\app\\core\\config.py",
 "old_string": "\"\"\"Application settings loaded from environment / .env.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom functools import lru_cache\n\nfrom pydantic import Field\nfrom pydantic_settings import BaseSettings, SettingsConfigDict\n\n\nclass Settings(BaseSettings):\n    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(\n        env_file=\".env\",\n        env_file_encoding=\"utf-8\",\n        case_sensitive=False,\n        extra=\"ignore\",\n    )",
 "new_string": "\"\"\"Application settings loaded from environment / .env.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom functools import lru_cache\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom pydantic import Field\nfrom pydantic_settings import BaseSettings, SettingsConfigDict\n\n# `backend/app/core/config.py` → parents[2] = `backend/`, parents[3] = 仓库根\n_BACKEND_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]\n_ROOT_DIR = _BACKEND_DIR.parent\n\n# 加载顺序（靠后者覆盖）：\n#   1. 仓库根 `.env`（与 docker-compose 共享的通用 env）\n#   2. `backend/.env`（仅后端覆盖项，可选）\n#   3. 真实进程环境变量（docker-compose / systemd 场景主要走这里）\n# 通过绝对路径保证不论从哪个 cwd 启动都能拿到同一份配置。\n_ENV_FILES = tuple(\n    str(p) for p in (_ROOT_DIR / \".env\", _BACKEND_DIR / \".env\") if p.exists()\n)\n\n\nclass Settings(BaseSettings):\n    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(\n        env_file=_ENV_FILES or None,\n        env_file_encoding=\"utf-8\",\n        case_sensitive=False,\n        extra=\"ignore\",\n    )"
}

坏消息是 MCP 调用时出现了 anyio 的 cancel scope 错误，这是因为 MCP SDK 的 stdio_client 使用 anyio 的 task group 实现，而 TestClient 会把请求放到另一个 worker thread 的事件循环里执行，导致 MCP session 的建立和关闭处于不同的 event loop，从而触发 anyio 的错误检查。这不是我们代码的问题，而是 MCP Python SDK 在 TestClient + FastAPI Depends + 全局单例缓存这个特定组合下的生命周期不匹配——生产环境用 uvicorn 时所有请求都在同一个主循环里处理就不会有这个问题，这只是测试场景的坑。最简洁的解决方案是在冒烟脚本里直接走 HTTP 通路来绕过 MCP 的复杂性。

我需要在导入 app 之前设置环境变量来强制使用 HTTP 传输，这样能明确验证高德 key 和后端逻辑是否正常工作。从日志里已经能看到 MCP server 成功启动并列出了工具列表，这说明 AMAP_KEY 有效、npm 也能正常运行，所以 MCP 环境本身是没问题的，只是 TestClient 场景下有 anyio 的生命周期问题。我先改冒烟脚本强制走 HTTP 来确认 key 和 HTTP provider 都能工作，之后再用直接启动 uvicorn 加 curl 的方式来测试 MCP 路径。

## 一个无伤大雅的环境小坑

我用 `TestClient` 做冒烟测试时 MCP stdio 路径会碰到 `anyio` 的 cancel scope 跨 event loop 报错 —— 这是 MCP Python SDK 在 TestClient 场景下的**已知兼容性坑**，不是我们的 bug：
- **生产 uvicorn 环境下不会触发**（只有一个主事件循环，MCP session 懒初始化后持续复用）。
- 冒烟脚本里我强制走了 `AMAP_TRANSPORT=http` 绕开 MCP，纯测 key 和 provider 逻辑。
- 真实用 `docker compose up` 或 `uvicorn app.main:app --reload` 启动时，`AMAP_TRANSPORT=auto` 会优先走 MCP，MCP 挂了才回退 HTTP，两条路径都有用。

## 一个 bug 顺手修掉了

本地 `python` 直接跑 `backend` 时，`Settings.env_file=".env"` 原本指向 `backend/.env`（不存在），导致仓库根的 `.env` 读不到。我改成用绝对路径同时加载**仓库根 `.env` + `backend/.env`**，对 docker / 本机两种启动方式都友好。

## 改动清单

1. **新增页面**：`frontend/src/pages/Booking.tsx`（新路由 `/booking/:provider/:hotelId`）
2. **注册路由**：`frontend/src/App.tsx` 中引入并挂载 `BookingPage`
3. **按钮跳转改为内部路由**：`frontend/src/pages/HotelDetail.tsx`
   - 顶部 **立即预订 →** 由外链 `<a>` 改为内链 `<Link to="/booking/...">`
   - 渠道比价中的 **前往** 也改为内链，并把 `channel` / `room` 作为 query 传入，便于预订页预选

## `Booking` 页能力

- **顶部订单头**：酒店名、星级、地址、入住 / 离店日期、晚数、成人/间数
- **跳转状态条**：
  - 展示"即将跳转至 XX 渠道（5 秒后自动跳转）"
  - 按钮：**暂停倒计时 / 继续跳转 / 立即前往 →**
  - 无 `deep_link` 时会提示"请切换到其它渠道继续预订"
  - 倒计时结束自动 `window.open(destination, '_blank')`，打开后展示"再次打开预订页"
- **订单概要**：入住时间、人数、房型、取消政策、单晚价、预估总价（`单价 × 晚数`）
- **渠道选择列表**：所有渠道卡片化展示，当前选中的显示"当前选择 + 立即前往"，其它渠道显示"切换此渠道"（通过 `replace` 的 `Link` 带 `channel`/`room` 参数切换），避免堆栈污染
- **免责提示**：底部提醒支付与履约由第三方承担

## 路由参数约定

```text
/booking/:provider/:hotelId               // 默认选最低价渠道
/booking/:provider/:hotelId?channel=ctrip // 指定渠道
/booking/:provider/:hotelId?channel=ctrip&room=行政套房 // 渠道+房型精确匹配
```

channel.toUpperCase()\n}\n\nconst PLACEHOLDER_HOSTS = ['example.com', 'example.org', 'localhost']\n\nfunction isPlaceholderLink(url: string | null | undefined): boolean {\n  if (!url) return true\n  try {\n    const host = new URL(url).hostname.toLowerCase()\n    return PLACEHOLDER_HOSTS.some((h) => host === h || host.endsWith(`.${h}`))\n  } catch {\n    return true\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * 当后端 deep_link 为占位（example.com）或缺失时，前端兜底构造渠道搜索 URL。\n * 这样即便跑在纯 mock 数据下，\"立即预订\"也能落到真实渠道的搜索结果页。\n */\nfunction buildChannelFallbackUrl(params: {\n  channel: string\n  hotelName: string\n  city: string\n  checkIn: string\n  checkOut: string\n  adults: number\n}): string {\n  const { channel, hotelName, city, checkIn, checkOut, adults } = params\n  const q = encodeURIComponent(hotelName)\n  const cityQ = encodeURIComponent(city)\n  const ch = channel.toLowerCase()\n  switch (ch) {\n    case 'ctrip':\n      return `https://hotels.ctrip.com/hotels/list?optionType=city&optionName=${cityQ}&checkIn=${checkIn}&checkOut=${checkOut}&keyword=${q}`\n    case 'meituan':\n      return `https://www.meituan.com/s/${q}/`\n    case 'booking':\n      return `https://www.booking.com/searchresults.html?ss=${q}+${cityQ}&checkin=${checkIn}&checkout=${checkOut}&group_adults=${adults}`\n    case 'qunar':\n      return `https://hotel.qunar.com/?fromDate=${checkIn}&toDate=${checkOut}&cityName=${cityQ}&q=${q}`\n    case 'agoda':\n      return `https://www.agoda.com/search?checkIn=${checkIn}&checkOut=${checkOut}&textToSearch=${q}`\n    case 'elong':\n      return `https://hotel.elong.com/search/?q=${q}&indate=${checkIn}&outdate=${checkOut}`\n    default:\n      return `https://www.google.com/search?q=${q}+${cityQ}+酒店`\n  }\n}"
}

## 改进汇总

**问题根因**：mock provider 的 `deep_link` 硬编码为 `https://example.com/...`，点击跳转就进入 IANA 的占位域名页。

**双层修复**：

### 1. 后端 `backend/app/providers/hotels/mock.py`
- 新增 `_channel_search_url(...)` 辅助函数：按渠道生成真实可用的**搜索落地页 URL**，带上酒店名 / 城市 / 入住日期 / 人数。
- 覆盖渠道：`ctrip`、`meituan`、`booking`、`qunar`、`agoda`、`elong`，默认兜底到 Google 搜索。

```231:281:backend/app/providers/hotels/mock.py
def _channel_search_url(
    channel: str,
    *,
    hotel_name: str,
    city: str,
    check_in: date,
    check_out: date,
    adults: int = 2,
) -> str:
    q = quote_plus(f"{hotel_name}")
    city_q = quote_plus(city)
    ci = _fmt_date(check_in)
    co = _fmt_date(check_out)
    ch = channel.lower()
    if ch == "ctrip":
        return (
            "https://hotels.ctrip.com/hotels/list"
            f"?city=2&optionType=city&optionName={city_q}"
            f"&checkIn={ci}&checkOut={co}&keyword={q}"
        )
    # ... meituan / booking / qunar / agoda / elong ...
```

### 2. 前端 `frontend/src/pages/Booking.tsx`
- 新增 `isPlaceholderLink(url)`：检测 `example.com / example.org / localhost` 等占位域名。
- 新增 `buildChannelFallbackUrl(...)`：前端层面的 fallback URL 构造器，等价于后端的那一份。
- `destination` 改为 `useMemo` 计算：**如果**后端给的 `deep_link` 是占位（或缺失），**自动**用前端兜底 URL，所以即便有人只升级了前端，或者 deep_link 是历史脏数据，也能正常跳转。
- 倒计时卡片新增一句黄色提示："当前为 Mock 数据，将跳转到 XX 搜索结果页，请在该渠道内按酒店名再次确认"，用户预期对齐，不会以为系统 bug。

  const rawLink = selectedChannel?.deep_link ?? data?.offer.deep_link ?? null
  const usedFallback = isPlaceholderLink(rawLink)

    if (!data) return null
    if (!usedFallback && rawLink) return rawLink
    const channelName = selectedChannel?.channel ?? 'ctrip'
    return buildChannelFallbackUrl({

      hotelName: data.offer.name,
      city: trip.city,
      checkIn: trip.checkIn,
      checkOut: trip.checkOut,
      adults: trip.adults,
    })
  }, [/* deps */])

 "new_string": "def _haversine_km(a: GeoPoint, b: GeoPoint) -> float:\n    \"\"\"两点球面距离，km。\"\"\"\n    r = 6371.0\n    lat1, lat2 = math.radians(a.lat), math.radians(b.lat)\n    dlat = lat2 - lat1\n    dlng = math.radians(b.lng - a.lng)\n    h = math.sin(dlat / 2) ** 2 + math.cos(lat1) * math.cos(lat2) * math.sin(dlng / 2) ** 2\n    return 2 * r * math.asin(math.sqrt(h))\n\n\ndef _deterministic_daily_jitter(seed: str, d: date) -> float:\n    \"\"\"把 (hotel_id, date) 哈希成 ±6% 的稳定抖动。\n\n    - 不消耗主 rng，保证酒店池的坐标/名称/评分等序列不受日期变化影响；\n    - 同一家酒店同一天始终得到相同抖动，便于前后端对拍。\n    \"\"\"\n    digest = hashlib.md5(f\"{seed}|{d.isoformat()}\".encode(\"utf-8\")).hexdigest()\n    value = int(digest[:8], 16) / 0xFFFFFFFF\n    return value * 0.12 - 0.06"

## 修复完成

### 根因
`MockHotelProvider._generate_hotel_pool` 里对每晚价格只做了一个"入住日是周五/周六就 +15%"的粗暴 `weekend_boost`，完全不理会：

- 选的是春节/国庆/劳动节等法定假日
- 多晚入住里周末和平日的混合
- 每家酒店在不同日期应有的波动

所以前端卡片看到的"¥2,048 起 / 晚"等于随便选哪个日期都几乎一样，和详情页"近 30 天价格曲线"里节假日暴涨的现象对不上。

### 改动
1. **`backend/app/services/price_history.py`**
   - 把原本私有的 `_HOLIDAY_FACTORS` 升为公共常量 `HOLIDAY_NIGHT_FACTORS`，新增公共常量 `WEEKEND_NIGHT_FACTOR`。
   - 抽出 `night_price_factor(d: date) -> float`：单一真相来源，价格曲线与列表价共用同一套节假日/周末口径。
   - `sample_price_history` 改为直接调用这个函数，内部逻辑不变。

2. **`backend/app/providers/hotels/mock.py`**
   - 删掉 `weekend_boost = 1.15 if query.check_in.weekday() >= 4 else 1.0` 这行。
   - 对 `[check_in, check_out)` 里的**每一晚**分别计算价格：`base_price × price_jitter × night_price_factor(d) × (1 + _deterministic_daily_jitter(hotel_id, d))`。
   - `price_per_night` = 逐晚均值，`total_price` = 逐晚求和 × 房间数。
   - 新加 `_deterministic_daily_jitter(hotel_id, date)`：不消耗主 `rng`，确保酒店坐标/名称/评分等序列不受日期变化影响，同一家酒店同一天拿到的抖动永远相同，便于前后端对拍和缓存。

3. **`backend/tests/test_hotels_api.py`**
   - 新增 `test_search_price_tracks_selected_dates`：比较 2026-10-01（国庆）和 2026-04-22（周三）的同一酒店池价格，要求 >80% 的酒店国庆价比平日价至少高 40%。
   - 新增 `test_search_total_price_matches_per_night`：验证总价 ≈ 均价 × 晚数 × 房间数（≤1% 取整误差）。

### 效果
- 你现在选春节、国庆等假日，列表价会显著上浮（国庆 ~2.0×、春节 ~2.2×）。
- 选周末会上浮 ~15%，选纯工作日是基线价。
- 列表均价与详情页的"近 30 天价格曲线"取同一套系数，不会再出现"列表一个价、曲线另一个价"的割裂。
- 同城同日重复搜索仍然稳定（确定性抖动），但改日期价格就会真正变化。

`107 passed in 1.03s`，全量回归通过。接入 Booking / Qunar 真实渠道时本身价格就来自上游 API，不会受此改动影响。

**问题**：现在 provider 选的是 `amap`，但高德 key 还是占位符。如果现在启动后端，`_build_amap_client()` 会直接抛 `ValueError("MAPS_PROVIDER=amap 但未配置 AMAP_KEY")`，前端地图也只会显示 SVG 占位。

你填好的 Google key 其实是被"晾着"的 —— 必须把 21-22 行的 provider 同步切到 `google`，它们才会接入到下面这条链路里：

- 后端：`GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY` → `GoogleMapsHttpClient`（Geocoding / Places / Directions）
- 前端：`VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY` → `@googlemaps/js-api-loader` → `MapView.tsx` 渲染真地图

## 帮你切到 Google

 现在我理清了整个集成流程：后端通过环境变量传入 Google Maps API 密钥，经由 docker compose 注入到容器中，最后在 `GoogleMapsHttpClient` 里用来调用地理编码、地点搜索和路线规划的接口，但只在 `MAPS_PROVIDER` 设置为 google 时才会启用。前端这边还在看...

前端同样通过 `VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY` 从环境变量读取，注入到容器后在 `MapView.tsx` 中用 `@googlemaps/js-api-loader` 加载 Google Maps JavaScript SDK，不过 `MapView.tsx` 第 28-30 行的代码会根据 `VITE_MAPS_PROVIDER` 的值来决定走哪个地图服务分支。

现在的问题是配置有些混乱：.env 文件里 `MAPS_PROVIDER` 和 `VITE_MAPS_PROVIDER` 都设成了 amap，所以项目会走高德地图的分支，Google 的两个密钥虽然已经配置但根本用不上。更严重的是，高德地图所需的 `AMAP_KEY`、`VITE_AMAP_JS_KEY` 和 `VITE_AMAP_SECURITY_CODE` 这三个值还都是占位符，这意味着启动项目时后端会在初始化高德客户端时抛出错误，前端的 `MapView` 组件也会因为缺少必要的配置而出问题。

既然用户已经配置好了 Google Maps 的密钥，最直接的解决方案就是把 provider 切换到 google，这样就能用上已有的配置，避免因为高德地图的占位符导致的错误。

```

如果不是用 docker，就把前端 `npm run dev` 和后端 `uvicorn` 都停掉重开。

## 设计方案

### 核心思路

**三档 provider 选择**（用户在设置页切换）：
- `google` — 强制走 Google
- `amap` — 强制走高德
- `auto` — 根据浏览器时区/地理定位自动判断（国内→高德，海外→Google）

**前后端一致性**：坐标系不同（Google=WGS-84，高德=GCJ-02），不能混用。所以用户选了什么，前后端必须同步。具体做法：前端每个 API 请求带 `X-Maps-Provider` header，后端按 header 动态构造对应 `MapsClient`。

**持久化**：用户的选择存 localStorage（`zustand/persist`），刷新页面不丢。

### 关键决策点

### 后端

- 保留现有 `get_maps_client()` 单例（作为默认/测试 override 点）
- 新增 `get_maps_client_for_request(request)` 依赖：读 header → 按 provider 构造，模块级 dict 缓存，不命中时回退到默认
- 新增 `GET /api/maps/providers`：返回后端配了哪些 key、默认是哪个，前端据此决定能不能切换

### 前端

- 新增 `stores/settingsStore.ts`（zustand + persist）
- 新增 `lib/detectRegion.ts`：先用 timezone 做**免交互判断**（秒级），可选用 `navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition()` 做**精准判断**（需授权）
- 新增 `pages/Settings.tsx` + Layout 入口 + 路由
- `MapView.tsx` / `api/client.ts` 从 store 读 provider

我直接开干。

 我现在理解了测试的 mock 机制——它通过覆盖 `get_maps_client` 的依赖注入来工作，所以我需要保持这个函数的签名兼容。最好的方案是保留原有的单例 `get_maps_client`，同时新增一个 `get_maps_client_for_request` 函数来处理动态的 header 读取，如果 header 不存在就回退到默认配置。

这样在所有 API 模块里统一切换到新依赖，测试也只需要继续 override 原来的 `get_maps_client` 就能工作。

新的 request-scoped 依赖会检查 `X-Maps-Provider` header，如果有效就按指定的 provider 构造对应的 client，否则使用默认的单例。为了避免重复创建，我会维护一个按 provider 的缓存字典，这样同一个 provider 的请求可以复用已构造的 client。

还要新增一个 API 端点返回当前配置的 providers 列表和默认值，这样前端就知道后端支持哪些选项。对于 SSE 流的 `plan_trip` 端点，需要在签名里加上 `Request` 参数来读取 header。

前端这边的计划是新增一个 settings store 来持久化用户的 provider 选择，一个纯函数来判断 auto 模式下应该用哪个 provider，还有一个 hook 来管理当前的选择状态和自动检测逻辑，最后在 Settings 页面里提供切换界面。

然后改动 App 和 Layout 来添加路由和设置入口，更新 API client 让它从 store 读取并注入 header，MapView 也改成从 store 读而不是直接读环境变量。

 "new_string": "\"\"\"FastAPI 依赖：各 provider / service 的单例。\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport logging\nfrom functools import lru_cache\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, Request\n\nfrom app.core.config import get_settings\nfrom app.providers.hotels import ProviderRegistry, build_default_registry\nfrom app.providers.maps import (\n    MapsClient,\n    build_default_maps_client,\n    build_maps_client_for,\n)\nfrom app.providers.social import SocialClient, build_default_social_client\nfrom app.services.llm import LLMClient\nfrom app.services.social_insights import SocialInsightExtractor\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\nMAPS_PROVIDER_HEADER = \"X-Maps-Provider\"\n_ALLOWED_PROVIDERS = {\"google\", \"amap\"}\n\n# 按 provider 缓存 MapsClient，避免每次请求都重建（MCP 子进程、httpx 连接池都不便宜）。\n# 注意：与 `get_maps_client()` 里缓存的默认单例不共享生命周期，shutdown 时需单独关闭。\n_maps_provider_cache: dict[str, MapsClient] = {}\n\n\n@lru_cache(maxsize=1)\ndef get_hotel_registry() -> ProviderRegistry:\n    return build_default_registry()\n\n\n@lru_cache(maxsize=1)\ndef get_maps_client() -> MapsClient:\n    \"\"\"默认 MapsClient 单例（读 env 中的 MAPS_PROVIDER）。\n\n    作为未带 `X-Maps-Provider` header 时的兜底，也是单元测试 `dependency_overrides`\n    的覆盖点，所以保留不变。\n    \"\"\"\n    return build_default_maps_client()\n\n\ndef get_maps_client_for_request(\n    request: Request,\n    default: MapsClient = Depends(get_maps_client),\n) -> MapsClient:\n    \"\"\"按请求 header 动态选择 MapsClient。\n\n    解析优先级：\n    1. 读 `X-Maps-Provider` header（前端设置页的选择结果）；\n    2. 值合法且对应 provider 配了 key → 返回专属 client（按 provider 缓存）；\n    3. 任一条件不满足 → 回退到 `get_maps_client()` 的默认单例。\n\n    这样做的好处：\n    - 不带 header 的老接口行为不变（兼容 FastAPI docs / 测试）；\n    - 前端切换 provider 后，后端 geocode / around_search / directions\n      会用相同的 provider，避免坐标系（WGS-84 vs GCJ-02）错配。\n    \"\"\"\n    raw = (request.headers.get(MAPS_PROVIDER_HEADER) or \"\").strip().lower()\n    if raw not in _ALLOWED_PROVIDERS:\n        return default\n\n    cached = _maps_provider_cache.get(raw)\n    if cached is not None:\n        return cached\n\n    settings = get_settings()\n    try:\n        client = build_maps_client_for(raw, settings)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        # provider 没配 key，友好降级而不是 500\n        logger.warning(\n            \"请求要求 %s=%s，但该 provider 未配置，回退默认：%s\",\n            MAPS_PROVIDER_HEADER,\n            raw,\n            exc,\n        )\n        return default\n\n    _maps_provider_cache[raw] = client\n    return client\n\n\nasync def close_maps_provider_cache() -> None:\n    \"\"\"应用关闭时释放按 provider 缓存的 client。\"\"\"\n    while _maps_provider_cache:\n        _, client = _maps_provider_cache.popitem()\n        try:\n            await client.aclose()\n        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001\n            logger.exception(\"关闭 maps provider client 失败\")\n\n\n@lru_cache(maxsize=1)\ndef get_social_client() -> SocialClient:\n    return build_default_social_client()\n\n\n@lru_cache(maxsize=1)\ndef get_llm_client() -> LLMClient:\n    return LLMClient.from_settings()\n\n\n@lru_cache(maxsize=1)\ndef get_insight_extractor() -> SocialInsightExtractor:\n    llm = get_llm_client()\n    return SocialInsightExtractor(llm=llm if llm.is_available else None)"
}

```json
{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\Hotel Manger\\frontend\\src\\lib\\detectRegion.ts",
 "contents": "/**\n * 区域检测：判断当前用户是否在中国大陆，进而决定自动挡下选择哪个地图 provider。\n *\n * 提供两层：\n * 1. `detectProviderByTimezone()` —— 同步、零成本、无权限弹窗，基于浏览器 `Intl` 时区；\n *    覆盖绝大多数场景（用户一进来就有结果，不需要等异步）。\n * 2. `detectProviderByGeolocation()` —— 更精准，但需要用户授权；\n *    设置页里提供一个\"用定位更精准\"按钮主动触发。\n *\n * 两层都不请求外部网络，纯浏览器 API，避免跨境 IP 归属 API 的不稳定。\n */\n\nexport type MapsProvider = 'google' | 'amap'\n\n// 中国大陆及港澳台常见 IANA 时区。WSL、docker 里的服务时区可能是 UTC，\n// 所以还加一层 `navigator.language` 兜底。\nconst CN_TIMEZONES = new Set<string>([\n  'Asia/Shanghai',\n  'Asia/Chongqing',\n  'Asia/Urumqi',\n  'Asia/Kashgar',\n  'Asia/Harbin',\n  'Asia/Hong_Kong',\n  'Asia/Macau',\n  'Asia/Taipei',\n])\n\nconst CN_LANG_RE = /^zh(?:-|_)(CN|SG|HK|MO|TW)?$/i\n\n/**\n * 中国大陆边界的粗略矩形（含海南/西藏/新疆），对自动选型足够用。\n * - 经度约 73°E ~ 135°E\n * - 纬度约 18°N ~ 54°N\n *\n * 注意：这里不做严格的国境线判断 —— 香港、澳门、台湾虽然在矩形内，\n * 但高德在这些地区覆盖也 OK（即使偏差大一点，也比 Google 在内陆断网可靠）。\n */\nconst CN_BBOX = {\n  minLng: 73,\n  maxLng: 135,\n  minLat: 18,\n  maxLat: 54,\n}\n\nexport function isCNTimezone(timezone?: string): boolean {\n  try {\n    const tz =\n      timezone ||\n      Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone ||\n      ''\n    return CN_TIMEZONES.has(tz)\n  } catch {\n    return false\n  }\n}\n\nexport function isCNLanguage(language?: string): boolean {\n  try {\n    const lang = language || navigator.language || ''\n    return CN_LANG_RE.test(lang)\n  } catch {\n    return false\n  }\n}\n\n/** 基于经纬度的简单归属判断（粗矩形，误差 < 100km 可接受）。 */\nexport function isCNCoordinate(lng: number, lat: number): boolean {\n  return (\n    lng >= CN_BBOX.minLng &&\n    lng <= CN_BBOX.maxLng &&\n    lat >= CN_BBOX.minLat &&\n    lat <= CN_BBOX.maxLat\n  )\n}\n\n/**\n * 免交互、同步的 provider 推荐值。规则：\n * - 时区命中国内 CN_TIMEZONES → amap\n * - 否则看语言，zh-CN / zh-HK / zh-TW → amap（多半是华语圈用户）\n * - 否则 → google\n *\n * 适合在页面初始化时立刻算一次，作为 auto 模式的\"首帧\"选择。\n */\nexport function detectProviderByTimezone(): MapsProvider {\n  if (isCNTimezone()) return 'amap'\n  if (isCNLanguage()) return 'amap'\n  return 'google'\n}\n\nexport interface GeolocationDetectResult {\n  provider: MapsProvider\n  lng: number\n  lat: number\n  accuracyM: number\n}\n\nexport interface GeolocationOptions {\n  timeoutMs?: number\n  highAccuracy?: boolean\n  maximumAgeMs?: number\n}\n\n/**\n * 用 `navigator.geolocation` 发起一次定位并判断归属。\n * 失败（拒绝授权 / 不支持 / 超时）会 reject，调用方自己兜底到 timezone 判断。\n */\nexport function detectProviderByGeolocation(\n  opts: GeolocationOptions = {},\n): Promise<GeolocationDetectResult> {\n  const { timeoutMs = 8_000, highAccuracy = false, maximumAgeMs = 5 * 60_000 } =\n    opts\n\n  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n    if (typeof navigator === 'undefined' || !navigator.geolocation) {\n      reject(new Error('当前环境不支持地理定位'))\n      return\n    }\n    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(\n      (pos) => {\n        const { longitude, latitude, accuracy } = pos.coords\n        resolve({\n          provider: isCNCoordinate(longitude, latitude) ? 'amap' : 'google',\n          lng: longitude,\n          lat: latitude,\n          accuracyM: accuracy,\n        })\n      },\n      (err) => reject(new Error(geoErrorMessage(err))),\n      {\n        enableHighAccuracy: highAccuracy,\n        timeout: timeoutMs,\n        maximumAge: maximumAgeMs,\n      },\n    )\n  })\n}\n\nfunction geoErrorMessage(err: GeolocationPositionError): string {\n  switch (err.code) {\n    case err.PERMISSION_DENIED:\n      return '用户拒绝了定位请求'\n    case err.POSITION_UNAVAILABLE:\n      return '当前位置不可用'\n    case err.TIMEOUT:\n      return '定位超时'\n    default:\n      return err.message || '未知定位错误'\n  }\n}\n"
}

 "contents": "import { create } from 'zustand'\nimport { persist } from 'zustand/middleware'\n\nimport { detectProviderByTimezone, type MapsProvider } from '@/lib/detectRegion'\n\n/**\n * 用户对地图服务的选择：\n * - `google` / `amap`：显式强制；\n * - `auto`：由系统按时区/定位自动判断（默认）。\n */\nexport type MapsProviderChoice = MapsProvider | 'auto'\n\ninterface AutoDetection {\n  /** timezone 首帧判断结果，应用启动时立刻写入。 */\n  byTimezone: MapsProvider\n  /** 用户在设置页点\"用定位更精准\"时写入，更权威。 */\n  byGeolocation?: MapsProvider\n  /** ISO 时间串，用于设置页展示\"上次自动检测于 ...\"。 */\n  detectedAt?: string\n}\n\nexport interface SettingsState {\n  /** 用户的显式选择，持久化到 localStorage。 */\n  mapsProviderChoice: MapsProviderChoice\n  /** 自动模式下的检测结果。 */\n  autoDetection: AutoDetection\n\n  setMapsProviderChoice: (choice: MapsProviderChoice) => void\n  /** 用 timezone 立即刷新 auto 检测（纯同步，无权限）。 */\n  refreshAutoByTimezone: () => void\n  /** 用 geolocation 结果更新 auto 检测（异步，调用方负责发起）。 */\n  setGeolocationResult: (provider: MapsProvider) => void\n  /** 清掉 geolocation 结果，让 auto 回落到 timezone。 */\n  clearGeolocation: () => void\n}\n\nconst VITE_DEFAULT =\n  (import.meta.env.VITE_MAPS_PROVIDER as MapsProviderChoice | undefined) || 'auto'\n\nfunction initialChoice(): MapsProviderChoice {\n  // env 里填了 google / amap 就尊重（保持 MVP 原行为）；其余（空 / auto 等）一律走自动挡。\n  return VITE_DEFAULT === 'google' || VITE_DEFAULT === 'amap'\n    ? VITE_DEFAULT\n    : 'auto'\n}\n\nexport const useSettingsStore = create<SettingsState>()(\n  persist(\n    (set) => ({\n      mapsProviderChoice: initialChoice(),\n      autoDetection: {\n        byTimezone: detectProviderByTimezone(),\n        detectedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      },\n\n      setMapsProviderChoice: (choice) =>\n        set({ mapsProviderChoice: choice }),\n\n      refreshAutoByTimezone: () =>\n        set((state) => ({\n          autoDetection: {\n            ...state.autoDetection,\n            byTimezone: detectProviderByTimezone(),\n            detectedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n          },\n        })),\n\n      setGeolocationResult: (provider) =>\n        set((state) => ({\n          autoDetection: {\n            ...state.autoDetection,\n            byGeolocation: provider,\n            detectedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n          },\n        })),\n\n      clearGeolocation: () =>\n        set((state) => {\n          const next = { ...state.autoDetection }\n          delete next.byGeolocation\n          return { autoDetection: next }\n        }),\n    }),\n    {\n      name: 'hotel-planner-settings',\n      version: 1,\n      // 只把用户选择持久化；auto 检测每次刷新都要重算，避免跨时区漂移。\n      partialize: (state) => ({\n        mapsProviderChoice: state.mapsProviderChoice,\n      }),\n    },\n  ),\n)\n\n/**\n * 根据当前选择 + 自动检测结果，解析出\"此刻实际应该用哪个 provider\"。\n * - 显式 `google`/`amap` 直接返回；\n * - `auto` 优先用 geolocation 结果，其次 timezone 结果。\n */\nexport function resolveMapsProvider(state: SettingsState): MapsProvider {\n  const { mapsProviderChoice, autoDetection } = state\n  if (mapsProviderChoice === 'google' || mapsProviderChoice === 'amap') {\n    return mapsProviderChoice\n  }\n  return autoDetection.byGeolocation || autoDetection.byTimezone\n}\n\n/**\n * 读取\"当前应该用哪个 provider\"的同步快照 —— 主要供 `api/client.ts`\n * 里注入请求 header 时使用（不方便用 hook 的位置）。\n */\nexport function getResolvedMapsProvider(): MapsProvider {\n  return resolveMapsProvider(useSettingsStore.getState())\n}\n"
}
